runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Towards rear, hampered after 400m, stayed on late into mid-field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居後列。跑了四百米後受阻礙。末段保持走勢，居中間位置過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Tracked pace, unable to quicken home straight and left behind by winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。直路上未能加速，被頭馬拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted out at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, showed no response early in straight, weakened and eased final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段對催策毫無反應。最後二百米轉弱，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Dropped out last from wide draw, still plenty to do top of home straight, making ground when severely checked 250m out, one paced after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。直路初仍落後甚遠。追前，二百五十米處大力勒避，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Sat off midfield 3 wide, one pace when asked. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。在催策下保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Crowded start, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, a bit closer on turn, angled out early in straight, finished off strongly to snatch victory in a ding-dong finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。直路初向外移出。衝刺強勁，在叮噹馬頭下險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上追前頗多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Settled well back from the widest barrier, ran on steadily down the centre of the track inside final 300M to reach 4th late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自最外檔出閘，遙居於後。最後三百米在跑道中央以穩勢上前，末段取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Mid-field, tight for room briefly 250m out, stayed on at the one pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。二百五十米處一度受緊迫。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, driven along 550m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處受催策，未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W2W) Held up in last pair after hampered early, still well back entering home straight, looked green, little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W2W) 早段受阻礙，其後留居最後兩位之內。入直路時仍遙居於後。看來走勢稚嫩，無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Prominent early, gradually taken backward reaching 11th on top of home bend, awkward on heels 700M out, dropped further behind into straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 早段居前列。逐漸留後，直路彎早段居第十一位。七百米處緊貼對手後蹄處於窘境。入直路時進一步墮後。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W) Mid-field, pushed along and dropped to rear bend, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W) 居中間位置。直路彎受推策及墮居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, weakened inside 200M, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列。最後二百米轉弱。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled well back from a wide barrier, baulked for a run in straight until the 250M and again 150M out, kept on well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，遙居於後。直路上受困直至二百五十米處。一百五十米處再度受困。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Tracked leaders, struggled to hold position from 500m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自五百米處起難以保持位置。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Bumped start, raced towards rear on the stands' side, made no impression final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步時發生碰撞，居後列，靠近外欄競跑。最後四百米毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover from 600M, 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。自六百米處起沒有遮擋。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, three wide in rear of mid-field, short-lived effort 300m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘後向內斜跑及與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。三百米處一度發力。其後在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Began awkwardly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, hung out in the home turn, one pace when asked. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。直路彎外閃。在催策下保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide in midfield early, dropped towards rear 600M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, closed off well without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。六百米處墮居後列。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W) Jumped awkwardly, held up, last entering home straight, passed a few under pressure late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W) 出閘笨拙，留後。入直路時居包尾位置。末段在催策下超越數匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Average to begin, raced in midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out after passing 700M, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過七百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat last, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Raced in touch, three wide, made effort 300m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 緊隨領先馬匹，走第三疊。三百米處發力。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on until weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速及領放。保持走勢直至最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Tracked pace, ridden to chase leading pair 400m out, unable to stay with that pair, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處在催策下追趕領先兩駒，但未能跟上。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, challenged up rail from 400m out, ran on well and lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。自四百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。保持佳勢，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began well, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 200M, ran on very well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上對催策反應甚佳，二百米處取得領先，保持甚佳走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W4W) Began well, raced 3 wide behind midfield, wider after passing 550M, 5 lengths or so back turning in, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。跑過五百五十米處後走更外疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位。衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Settled worse than midfield on the rail, made minor progress. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Ridden along in last few on rail after moderate start, baulked behind runners from the 800M and forced to check 700M out, fought on steadily from one of the widest into straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，受催策，居最後數位內，走內欄。自八百米處起在馬匹之後受困，七百米處被迫勒避。入直路時為走最外疊馬匹之一，持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Ridden to midfield some 5L back in 6th about 1100M out, slightly worse rounding home bend, kept on same pace without quickening under pressure in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 受催策，居中間位置。約千一米處居第六位，落後約五個馬位。轉直路彎時略為墮後。直路上受催策，但未能加速，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Bumped shortly after the start, raced at rear on the inside, angled out 500M, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走內疊。五百米處向外移出。直路早段略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Sat on pace, weakened quickly inside 200M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。二百米處迅速轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped on jumping, raced behind midfield on the outside, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Slowly away, dropped out from widest draw, widest into home straight, made up some late ground but never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘緩慢，墮後。入直路時走最外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W3W) Jumped awkwardly and ridden quietly from the tail of the field, overraced early stages, severely checked to avoid an accident around the 900M, showed limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W3W) 出閘笨拙，居包尾位置，未受催策。早段搶口。約九百米處時大力勒避一宗意外。末段對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat box seat, kept on okay, nothing extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。保持不俗走勢。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, ran on well to close on leaders but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 居中間位置。未能望空直至三百米處。末段以佳勢追近領先馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W6W) Held up very wide in last few without cover after beginning from a poor draw, travelling keenly and pulled closer very wide rounding home bend, one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W6W) 自第十三檔出閘後留後，居最後數位之內，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。跑來搶口。轉直路彎時追近，走大外疊。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, raced keenly in the middle stages, closed off well only beaten less than 3L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。中段搶口。衝刺良佳。僅以不足三個馬位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, didn't settle, had to wait for run over 300m out, switched 200m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，未能穩定走勢。三百米處須等待空位出現。二百米處轉換跑線。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Settled one back in 3rd on rail within 2L of pace, angled out for a run entering home straight and faded gradually out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居第三位，落後領放馬不足兩個馬位，走內欄。入直路時向外移出取位。其後逐漸力竭，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Began well, raced prominently on the outside, a length back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat at rear, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 100M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W3W4W) Jumped with them, crowded near 1100M, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, a bit closer on turn, very wide into straight, made some progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，接近千一米處時受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W3W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, switched wide for clear run top of home straight, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路初移出外疊以望空。保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled behind midfield, traveled fairly, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居中間之後位置，走勢一般。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Mid-field, headway 400m out, unable to sustain and flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處上前。未能保持走勢，最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along to race in rear early stages, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，早段在推策下居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, held up last, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on well, crowded closing stages and unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，留居包尾位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持佳勢，末段受擠迫，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat handy, kept on well to hold 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居前列。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Stayed close enough to leaders early stages before settling down in midfield 3-wide, couldn't go on passing 200M, weakened away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 早段保持緊隨領先馬匹，其後留居中間位置，走第三疊。跑過二百米處時無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted in and bumped exiting stalls, ridden along from stalls to across, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, tired closing stages and headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，受催策以切入。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段呈疲態，接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, commenced move out wide 600m out, under pressure 400m out, stuck to task, checked close home and lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處開始發力，走外疊。四百米處受催策，持續力拼。接近終點時勒避，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Sat handy 2 wide, raced keenly, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居前列，走第二疊。搶口。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W6W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W6W) 居中間位置。走勢一般。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, angled out 500M, showed limited response early in straight, peaked on run 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 出閘普通，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路初對催策反應平平。二百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, sat midfield, made steady progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置。其後穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Mid-division, ridden along over 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置。三百米處受催策，未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初受催策，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, had to wait for run early in home straight, clear run final 200m, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路早段須等待空位出現。最後二百米望空，保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, made good ground inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置。二百米處追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, never going pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。從未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Slow to begin, taken back to race at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back, same margin back turning in, made some progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘緩慢，留居後列，落後約六個馬位，走外疊。入直路時落後相同距離。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Soon taken back from a wide barrier settling in rear on rail, met minor interferences 800M out, saved ground on rail turning in for home, shifted out for a run on straightening, produced good late impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即留居後列，走內欄。八百米處略受干擾。轉直路彎時走內欄節省腳程。入直路時向外移出取位。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, pushed along 500m out, short-lived effort top of home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。五百米處受推策。直路初一度發力。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, angled off rail 700m out, ran on well in home straight, lost out only narrowly in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百米處移離內欄。直路上以佳勢上前。在多駒幾乎齊過終點下僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, had to wait for run turning into home straight, bumped 250m out, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。二百五十米處發生碰撞。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until approaching final 100M, finished off well to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 起步時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近一百米處。衝刺良佳，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure 700m out, strong run final 400m to lead 75m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百米處受催策。最後四百米走勢強勁。七十五米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, same position on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路早段略為追前，一百五十米處未能再增速，最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, raced in touch with leaders, keen throughout, driven 500m out, unable to quicken, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。沿途搶口。五百米處受催策。未能加速，最後二百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Crowded and bumped out of stalls, ridden along from stalls to press leader, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 出閘時受擠迫，發生碰撞，其後受催策，追逼領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W2W2W) Began well from the widest draw, raced slightly better than midfield on outer early, moved closer after passing 1000M, 2nd in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，早段居中間稍前位置，走外疊。跑過一千米處後追近，中段居第二位。直路初未能再增速，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W1W) Away with them, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, took the lead 1100M, found rail after passing 900M, led by a length on turn, peaked and headed 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。千一米處取得領先。跑過九百米處後移入內欄。直路彎領先一個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began only fairly, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, no clear run early in straight, cleared 150M but made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路初未能望空。一百五十米處望空，但其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居領放馬之後，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled nicely, switched out entering the Straight, closed off well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走勢良佳。入直路時向外移出。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 3 wide, a length or so back, sent forward after passing 1200M, took the lead 1050M, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，落後約一個馬位，走第三疊。跑過千二米處後受催策上前。一千零五十米處取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run top of home straight, challenged up rail from 300m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初須等待空位出現。自三百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, some headway on bend, short of room early in home straight, effort 200m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路彎略為追前。直路早段空位不足。二百米處發力。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Waited with towards rear, driven along 400m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處受催策，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 400M, made some progress in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。四百米處向外移出。直路上略為追前，跑獲季軍，未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, dropped away quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。末段迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, tight for room early in home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初受緊迫，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, headway halfway out, switched wide for clear run top of home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。半程時上前。直路早段移出外疊以望空。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Raced wide throughout, disputed led on bend, headed by winner 550m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 沿途走外疊。直路彎爭奪領先。五百五十米處被頭馬超越。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。自四百米處起受催策，但未能加速。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Raced very wide throughout in rear, shuffled back 400m out, lost touch final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 沿途居後列，走大外疊。四百米處墮後。最後三百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Chased leaders, ridden along 350m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;追趕領先馬匹。三百五十米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Tracked leaders, unable to hold position halfway, flattened out final 200m.
(Mucus in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;緊隨領先馬匹。半程時未能保持位置。最後二百米洩氣。
（氣管有痰。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; Shared led on the stands' rail, weakened final furlong.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;並排領先，走外欄。最後二百米轉弱。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat on pace 3 from the stands' rail, kept on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居前列，走外欄第四疊。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Disputed led, ridden to chase leader 400m out, ran on well to close on winner late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;爭奪領先。四百米處在催策下追趕領放馬。末段以佳勢追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled some 2L back on rail early stages, drifted further off the pace into 5th inside the 650M, gradually weakened under pressure in straight.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 早段落後約兩個馬位，走內欄。六百五十米處進一步墮居第五位。直路上在催策下逐漸轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in mid-field, crowded and lost balance 600m out, checked 350m out, unable to recover, eased once well held.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。六百米處受擠迫及失去平衡。三百五十米處勒避，未能恢復走勢，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, rail position throughout, unable to quicken 400m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。沿途走內欄。四百米處未能加速。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Crowded at start, waited with in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W5W) Jumped awkwardly, in midfield early stages before dropping back towards the rear, brought wide into straight but the finishing response was just fair.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W5W) 出閘笨拙。早段居中間位置，其後墮居後列。入直路時移出外疊，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Crowded shortly after start settling just behind midfield in 8th, baulked for a run early in home straight, produced good late impression inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘後不久受擠迫，居中間稍後的第八位。直路早段受困。最後一百米追前頗多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) From draw 11 obtained a position behind midfield, 6Ls off leader home turn, responded fairly when brought wide to challenge on straightening. Never a serious threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 自第十一檔出閘，居中間之後位置。直路彎落後領放馬六個馬位。入直路時移出外疊以展開挑戰，對催策反應一般。從未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W5W) Raced ungenerously when being steadied to attempt to obtain cover early stages, unable to do so and raced wide without cover behind midfield, couldn't accelerate enough on straightening. No threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W5W) 早段在收慢以嘗試取得遮擋之際走勢欠順。未能取得遮擋，居中間之後位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時加速力不足。未能威脅領先馬匹。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 3-year-old gelding, by Written By from Now You See, a daughter of Magic Albert. Horses by the same sire include Steps Ahead and Super Sixty. He was given seven trials in Hong Kong for one win. He shared the lead and won under the whip, by 3Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on July 7. In the latest trial, he sat near the rear and finished sixth under pressure, beaten by 14-1/4Ls, over 1050m AWT at Sha Tin on September 1. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「執筆人」(Written By)之後，在港同父馬包括「遙遙領先」及「超強六十」等駒，生母出自Magic Albert。抵港後七次試閘得一勝。7月7日出試田泥1200米，早段並頭領放，末段鞭策下以三個馬位之先勝出。最近9月1日出試田泥1050米，早段跟前，末段力策下跑第六名，落後頭馬14.25個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Graff from Baroness de Ville, a daughter of Smart Missile. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong. He was given four trials in Hong Kong for three wins. He sat midfield and won under slight pressure, by a short-head, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on June 8. In the latest trial, he raced handily and won under pressure, by a neck, over 1000m on turf at Sha Tin on August 30. He looks an interesting debutant and could run well here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「貴乎珠寶」(Graff)之後，為此父系首匹子嗣在港上陣，生母出自「智能導彈」(Smart Missile)。抵港後四次試閘得三勝。6月8日出試從化草地1000米，早段居中，末段稍騎下以短馬頭位之先勝出。最近8月30日出試田草1000米，早段跟前，末段力策下以一馬頸位之先勝出。初出應可交出良好表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Towards rear of mid-field on outer, pushed along 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置，離外欄競跑。四百米處受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Moderately away, raced in midfield on the stands' side, made no progress final 400M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，居中間位置，靠近外欄競跑。最後四百米毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in midfield early. Made good progress over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;早段於馬群中間競跑。末段走勢良好。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact shortly after start, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on the stands' rail, same position in the middle stages, not enough room until 150M, made some progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久與他駒互相觸碰，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走外欄。中段居相同位置。空位不足直至一百五十米處。其後略為追前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Mid division towards centre of course, pushed along halfway out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。半程時受推策，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Made contact with the right side of its starting gate, raced prominently, difficult to settle in the early stages, made contact 900M, 2 lengths back on turn, weakened early in straight, eased final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時觸碰閘廂右側，居前列。早段難以穩定走勢。九百米處發生觸碰。直路彎落後兩個馬位。直路早段轉弱，最後一百五十米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Not the best away, recovered to race mid-field, keen, under pressure 400m out, limited response, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘並非最快。恢復走勢，居中間位置，搶口。四百米處受催策，反應平平。保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began awkwardly and made contact, raced prominently on the outside, travelled keenly in the early stages, 1-3/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，居前列，走外疊。早段搶口。入直路時落後一又四分三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, weakened quickly over 300m out, eased final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。三百米處迅速轉弱。最後二百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Waited with in mid-field, pushed along when tight for room 200m out, no impression when again short of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，留力候上。二百米處受推策，但受緊迫。末段再度缺乏空位，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Caught 3 wide off pace, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後競跑，走第三疊。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Prominent chasing leader under 7lb claimer, fought on early straight to stay in contention, lost 2nd nearing 200M, no extra final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在獲減七磅的騎師胯下居前列，追趕領放馬。直路初力拼以保持爭逐機會。接近二百米處時失去第二位。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the outside, travelled keenly in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, made contact and unbalanced near 250M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間位置，走外疊。中段搶口。直路初未能再增速。接近二百五十米處時與對手互相觸碰，失去平衡，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; In rear after sluggish start, raced keenly 700M out, held when checked near 250M, recovered well and made up steady ground (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;起步緩慢，居後列。七百米處搶口。接近二百五十米處時在勒避之際受困。末段迅速恢復走勢。其後穩步上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in midfield early. Not much progress over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;早段於馬群中間競跑。末段進展不大。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat box-seat, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W3W) Sat behind the leaders on the rail, hung out rounding the Home Turn, eased down soon after. (Racing Manners Unacceptable, must trial) (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。轉直路彎時外閃，其後瞬即收慢。（走勢難以接受，必須試閘及格。）（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) Average to begin, raced in 3rd, 1 to 2 lengths back, 2nd on turn, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘一般，居第三位，落後一至兩個馬位。直路彎居第二位。直路早段略為追前，最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, easy run to turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off strongly, won by 2 lengths.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。入直路後保持走內疊。衝刺強勁，以兩個馬位之先掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Three wide in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 居後列，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但未能增速以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Shared lead on rail early. Overhauled at 900M. Weakened at 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 早段沿欄並頭領放。九百米被超越。二百米力弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped shortly after start, settled in rear of mid-field, under pressure 500m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, unable to quicken in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Jumped only fairly, raced slightly behind midfield on the stands' side, inconvenienced near 650M, 3 to 4 lengths back at 400M, kept on one-paced to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍後位置，靠近外欄競跑。接近六百五十米處時受妨礙。四百米處落後三至四個馬位。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Mid-field towards outer, headway alongside winner 300m out, run petered out final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，離外欄競跑。三百米處與頭馬一同追前。最後一百五十米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Raced keenly throughout and had to make a wide forward move from the 700M, ran out abruptly near the 150M, faded and eased down thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 沿途搶口。自七百米處起須自外疊發力上前。接近一百五十米處時急促向外斜跑，力竭，其後收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened and eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑及觸碰對手，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱及收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, 2 wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 留居後列，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。末段以穩勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Settled rear, raced keenly in the early stages, was held up for clear running until 300M, responded well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 居後列，早段搶口。三百米處前受困而未能望空。末段對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, race keenly throughout, angled off rail 400m out, short of room final 200m, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。沿途搶口。四百米處移離內欄。最後二百米空位不足，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked pace, struggled to hold position top of home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。直路初難以保持位置。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Not hurried on jumping from draw 1, settled in second half of the field, ran on only fairly in the straight. No threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘，未受催策，居後半馬群中。直路上走勢僅屬一般。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat last, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包尾位置。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) From draw 1 given a patient ride in a rearward spot, had some work to do top of the straight, lacked a turn of foot and couldn't launch a serious challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後居後列，留力候上。直路初仍落後甚遠。未能加速以展開真正挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Settled well behind and waited with, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, produced strong late finish between runners inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 遙居於後，留力候上。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。最後二百米在馬匹之間衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4 lengths back turning in, showed no response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，與對手互相觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路初對催策毫無反應，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, steadied near 800M, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。接近八百米處時收慢。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上未能以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Sat at the rear, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Sat towards the rear, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居後列。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Sat last, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat worse than midfield, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Began only fairly, raced towards rear on the inside, 7 lengths or so back turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。轉入直路時落後約七個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Taken back to race towards rear on the outside, moved a bit closer after passing 750M, very wide turning in, finished off strongly to gain a dead heat victory. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 留居後列，走外疊。跑過七百五十米處後略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺強勁，取得平頭冠軍。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon taken across from a poor draw for rails run at the back, commenced move coming onto home bend improving under pressure to within 4L of pace in 7th briefly early in straight, unable to sustain effort inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即切入內欄，居後列。開始轉直路彎時開始上前，在催策下推進，直路早段一度居第七位，落後領放馬不逾四個馬位。最後一百五十米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, forced to steady 1000m out, under pressure 500m out, ran on well to lead close home in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。一千米處被迫收慢。五百米處受催策。走勢良佳，接近終點時在多駒幾乎齊過終點下率先衝線。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, mid division, keen middle stages, driven along 500m out, ran on well final 200m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置。中段搶口。五百米處受催策。最後二百米以佳勢上前，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped exiting stalls, rail position in mid-field, short of room early in home straight, not best of runs final 200m but ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。直路早段空位不足。最後二百米未能完全望空，但走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Sat towards rear, held up at the Turn, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 居後列。直路彎受困。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded start, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Chased leader, switched for clear run final bend, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 追趕領放馬。直路彎轉換跑線以望空。直路早段加速，二百米處取得領先。接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the outside, 5 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made some progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，落後約五個馬位，走外疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上略為追前，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, short of room early in home straight, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，未能跟上步速。直路初空位不足。末段走勢良佳，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Mid-field, one paced under pressure, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持同速。未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, raced in rear, switched top of home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居後列。直路初轉換跑線。末段未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last pair top of home straight, no impression.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W5W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居最後兩位，毫無表現。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Sat midfield 3 wide with cover, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked pace, pushed along 400m out, stuck to task but one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處受推策。持續力拼，但保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Led on rail early. Weakened at 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段沿欄領放。二百米力弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, tired closing stages and headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段呈現疲態，接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast break, made all, quickened top of home straight, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，一直領放。直路初加速。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, good headway on bend, ridden top of home straight to challenge leader, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎以佳勢上前。直路初在催策下挑戰領放馬。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden hard to lead, slightly weakened passing 200M
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 在力策下領放。跑過二百米處時略為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。未能望空直至二百米處。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early in home straight to lead, weakened final 100m and headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路早段加速上前取得領先。最後一百米轉弱，接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat towards the rear, no clear run early part of the Straight, stayed on well once in the clear. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列。直路早段未能望空。末段望空後隨即保持佳勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W3W) Settled at the rear, stayed on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居後列。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, pushed along on bend to chase leaders, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路彎受推策以追趕領先馬匹。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Taken back from gate 10, raced 3 wide at rear, very wide into straight, made minor progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 自第十檔出閘，留居後列，走第三疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Crowded start, raced 2 wide towards rear, there to turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能望空，二百米處望空，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat at the rear, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居後列。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Sat towards rear, traveled strongly, made ground from the back.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 居後列，走勢強勁。末段自後列追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, sent forward to take the lead, shared lead with rival turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，受催策上前領放。入直路時與對手並排領先。二百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Sat behind the lead, nothing extra in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 居領放馬之後。直路上再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W1W1W) Ridden to soon take up running onto back straight setting a sound pace, led the field until finding no extra over 200M out, lost a placing late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W1W1W) 受催策，進入對面直路時瞬即取得領先，以快步速領放。保持領先直至二百米處再無餘力。末段失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W) Made running and set fast pace, challenged from 150m out, responded well, headed only close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W) 以快步速領放。自一百五十米處起受挑戰。對催策反應良佳，僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well and led on the rail, kept on until weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，沿欄領放。保持走勢直至最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sat handy, traveled greenly, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居前列。走勢稚嫩。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled midfield, raced keenly, lay in in the Straight, difficult to ride out (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，搶口。直路上內閃，難以被力策。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, stayed on well but unable to reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。末段保持佳勢，但未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled fairly, weakened passing 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 在催策下領放。走勢一般。跑過二百米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Pushed along from stalls to lead, challenged by rivals 500m out, headed by runner-up 200m out, fought back to lead again 50m out, just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘後受推策以取得領先。五百米處受對手挑戰。二百米處被亞軍馬匹超越。五十米處反先該駒再次取得領先，險勝而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the outside, 2 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，落後約兩個馬位，走外疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Tracked leader, pushed along to chase leader 600m out, stayed on well and just held on in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 跟隨領放馬。六百米處受推策以追趕領放馬。保持佳勢，在多駒幾乎齊過終點下僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Jumped awkwardly, raced 3 wide slightly behind midfield, similar position on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 200M, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初未能望空。跑過二百米處後望空。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began only fairly, positioned 3 wide with cover, 4 lengths or so back, similar position on turn, finished off well to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，落後約四個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎位置相若。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, pressed in front, headed by winner top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 展現甚佳前速以領放。在領放下受追迫。直路初被頭馬超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Settled in rear of mid-field, ridden to maintain position 700m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 居中間之後位置。七百米處受催策以保持位置。保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, under pressure to settle in mid-field, smooth headway and ridden on bend, stayed on well but no match for winner.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，受催策下居中間位置。以暢順走勢上前，直路彎受催策。保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W3W) Tracked pace, keen under restraint and forced to commence move out wide 600m out, good headway to take the lead 300m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。在約束下搶口。六百米處被迫開始上前，走外疊。以佳勢上前，三百米處取得領先。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rival turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened 150M, eased final 50M.
(Near the 350 Metres jockey dropped his whip.)
runnerrecords.incident_eng: (Near the 350 Metres jockey dropped his whip.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時受對手挑戰。三百米處未能再增速及被超越。一百五十米處轉弱，最後五十米收慢。
（於接近三百五十米處時騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於接近三百五十米處時騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W) Amongst leaders 5-wide early stages, shifted one-back for cover coming onto home bend but in vain, weakened under pressure inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W) 早段居領先馬群之中，走第五疊。入直路彎時留後一個馬位以取得遮擋，但未能成功。最後三百米在催策下轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Bumped exiting stalls, driven along and outpaced early stages, pushed along widest into home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W4W5W) Moderately away, raced in midfield on the outside, made contact near 700M, peaked turning in, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W4W5W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走外疊。接近七百米處時發生觸碰。入直路時未能再增速，直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W7W) Did not show sufficient pace early stages to hold a more forward position as intended, made a wide move from the rear at middle of the turn before closing off fairly in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W7W) 早段未能展現足夠前速以佔取如賽前部署般較為靠前的位置。直路彎中段沿外疊自後列發力上前，其後在直路上衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Well there from a poor draw, came to share the pace rounding home bend gaining slender lead upon straightening, led until finding no extra 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，居好位。轉直路彎時上前並排領先。入直路時領先些微距離。領先直至一百五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead until 1200M, weakened inside 200M, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下領放至千二米處。最後二百米轉弱。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W5W) 自最外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Settled just worse than midfield on rail, came under pressure upon straightening but had nothing to give.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間稍後位置，走內欄。入直路時受催策，但再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped well from gate 1, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, 4 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W4W) Taken back to race 3 wide towards rear, similar position on turn, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W4W) 留居後列，走第三疊。直路彎前居相若位置。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再加速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Slightly slow out, raced in midfield on the inside, 2 wide after passing 700M, peaked early in straight, eased final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，居中間位置，走內疊。跑過七百米處後走第二疊。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield, traveled nicely, made good progress inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走勢良佳。二百米處追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Broke well, bumped and unbalanced before settling in midfield, commenced move 3-wide rounding home bend reaching within 1L of the pace into straight, responded well to take charge about 250M out, hung on well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 出閘迅速，被碰撞，失去平衡，其後居中間位置。轉直路彎時開始發力，走第三疊。入直路時落後領放馬不逾一個馬位。對催策反應良佳，約二百五十米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Mid-field, repeatedly short of room in home straight when looking to improve, not fully extended.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。直路上嘗試推進之際一再空位不足。未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, under pressure to hold position from 650m out, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。自六百五十米處起在催策下保持位置。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W4W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, wide throughout, pushed along widest into home straight, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W4W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。沿途走外疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W2W4W) Bumped shortly after start, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, very wide into straight, finished off very strongly to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W2W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺凌厲，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 400M, unable to obtain clear run in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。直路上未能望空。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, forced to steady on heels 900m out, improved to rear of mid-field 700m out, lost balance on bend and 250m out, faded final.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後墮退，九百米處被迫收慢避開他駒的後蹄，七百米處推進至中間之後位置。直路彎及二百五十米處失去平衡。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Towards rear, headway early part of home straight but unable to reach leaders, tight for room close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列。直路早段追前，但未能追及領先馬匹。接近終點時受緊迫。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Mid division, had to wait for run turning into home straight, short of room 400m out to 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。四百米處至一百米處空位不足。際遇欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W) In rear after crowded at start, had to wait for run top of home straight, switched wide for clear run 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列。直路初須等待空位出現。一百米處移出外疊以望空。敗在欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Held up last, race keenly throughout, pushed along widest into home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 留居包尾位置。沿途搶口。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W6W) Taken back to race towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W6W) 留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded and checked leaving stalls, in rear, rail position throughout, unable to quicken in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘時受擠迫及勒避。沿途居後列，走內欄。直路上未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Made contact at start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空，二百米處望空。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W) Waited with in rear, unable to secure clear run until 250m out, stayed on well but ran out of time.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。未能望空直至二百五十米處。保持佳勢，但為時已晚。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, driven along 500m out, stayed on well to close on winner late but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策。保持佳勢，末段追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, short of room early in home straight, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初空位不足，未能望空直至二百米處。末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊，最後二百米衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled midfield, traveled only fairly, gave ground inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走勢僅屬一般。二百米處墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, there to turn, failed to make any progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced 2 wide towards rear, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時被碰撞及失去平衡，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, pushed along to chase leaders 450m out, gave ground final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。四百五十米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。最後一百五十米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, pressed on final bend and two lengths clear top of home straight, reeled in and headed 50m out, clear of remainder.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 帶頭競跑。直路彎受催策，直路初領先兩個馬位。其後逐漸被追近，五十米處被超越，但仍拋離其他對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Crowded at start, dropped out from wide draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 自外檔起步時受擠迫，墮居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Moderately away, raced slightly better than midfield on the outside, peaked 500M, weakened early in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。五百米處未能再增速。直路初轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Mid division, checked 1000m out, keen 600m out, bumped and lost balance 500m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。一千米處勒避。六百米處搶口。五百米處發生碰撞及失去平衡。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, a bit closer on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎略為追近。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Out in line, trapped wide in midfield, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened final 300M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊，大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速。最後三百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Hampered shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, there to turn, finished off well to take a place.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受阻礙，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Not far off 4-wide early stages, gradually improved to 2L 2nd 2-wide 900M out, kept on under pressure from a similar position into home straight but could find no extra 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 早段落後領放馬不遠，走第四疊。逐漸上前，九百米處居第二位，落後兩個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時位置相若，在催策下保持走勢，但最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Gradually recovered from moderate start to over 3L back in 5th about 1000M out, drifted further off the fast pace to some 4L back around home bend, renewed effort inside final 300M to do best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，其後逐漸恢復走勢，約一千米處居第五位，落後逾三個馬位。其後進一步落後步速快的領放馬，轉直路彎時落後約四個馬位。最後三百米重新發力，末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Raced in touch with leaders, keen, unable to quicken under pressure over 300m out, no extra and lost ground final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹，搶口。三百米處在催策下未能加速。最後一百五十米再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Average to begin, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Average to begin, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out early in straight, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初向外移出。衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled strongly, had every chance (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 在催策下取得領先。走勢強勁。已獲機會盡展所長。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat towards rear on the rail, switched out entering the Straight, made steady progress to the line.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內欄。入直路時向外移出。末段穩步上前。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W6W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide with cover, turned very wide into the home straight, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W6W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, did not finish off after being crowded near 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。接近三百米處時受擠迫，其後未能以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly and crowded, raced at tail, 7 to 8 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般及受擠迫，居包尾位置。入直路時落後七至八個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Encryption from Epsilon, a daughter of Sequalo. Horses by the same sire include Pegas and Lucky Gibs. He was given four trials in Hong Kong for one placing. He sat midfield and finished third under slight pressure, beaten by 5-3/4Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on July 7. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished tenth under a hold, beaten by 36-1/4Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on August 28. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「加密」(Encryption)之後，在港同父馬包括「飛馬座」及「金津寶駒」等駒，生母出自Sequalo。抵港後四次試閘一次上名。7月7日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬5.75個馬位。最近8月28日出試田泥1200米，早段跟前，末段按韁下跑第十名，落後頭馬36.25個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover off pace, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居領放馬之後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Sat outside lead, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速，最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Pushed to a forward position just outside leader, struggled to keep up entering home straight, weakened away badly to finish last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 受推策佔取前列位置，在領放馬外側競跑。入直路時難以跟上對手。嚴重轉弱，包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped ok and sat midfield one off, failed to find extra gear to close off his first race in Hong Kong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在港首次上陣。出閘尚可，居中間位置，走第二疊。末段未能加速以展開衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Sat off pace 2 wide, gave ground final furlong. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。最後二百米墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, travelled up smoothly top of the Straight, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路初走勢暢順。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) In last few early stages, forced to check 900M out before pulling forward wide around home bend, fought on under pressure from just over 2L back into straight until finding no extra close to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 早段居最後數位內。九百米處被迫勒避。轉直路彎時上前，走外疊。入直路時落後稍逾兩個馬位，在催策下力拼，直至接近終點時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W) Started well from wide draw and across to make running, came under pressure 200m out, challenged by runner-up final 100m, responded and always holding that rival final 50m despite edging left.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，切入領放。二百米處受催策。最後一百米受亞軍馬匹挑戰。最後五十米雖然向外斜跑，但對催策交出反應，一直力拒該匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Taken back to race 2 wide towards rear, angled out after passing 400M, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 留居後列，走第二疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。轉入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W) Lifted front feet on jumping, raced prominently but trapped wide early, slightly taken back after passing 1000M, raced 3 wide better than midfield on turn, challenged the leader early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W) 躍出時一對前腳並舉，早段居前列，但走外疊。跑過一千米處後略為留後。直路彎居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路初挑戰領放馬。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, ridden top of home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初受催策，在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Moderately away, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，緊隨領放馬，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, same position on turn, peaked early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (6W2W2W) Moderately away from the widest draw, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, dropped towards rear on turn, emptied early in straight, eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(6W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。直路彎墮居後列。直路早段力竭，其後收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat behind midfield, gave limited response turning home, couldn't sustain run mid-straight then faded to finish last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置。轉直路彎時對催策反應平平。直路中段無以為繼。其後力竭，包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, raced keenly, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。搶口。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, struggled to hold position on bend, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
(Blood in mouth.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時被碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎難以保持位置。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。
（口內有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Began awkwardly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back, wider turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，落後五個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上追前頗多，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled worse than midfield, raced ungenerously in the early and middle stages, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。早段及中段走勢欠順。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Mid-field, ridden when short of room and switched 300m out, unable to quicken and little impression after.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處受催策時空位不足，轉換跑線。其後未能增速，無甚表現。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Sat 3 wide on pace, kept on without threatening
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact shortly after start, raced at rear, 5 lengths back in the middle stages, made no impression final 400M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居後列。中段落後五個馬位。最後四百米毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced towards rear on the stands' side, short of room final 400M, not able to test properly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘笨拙及失地，居後列，走外欄。最後四百米空位不足。未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; In rear after slow start, ran green, stayed on late down the wide outside.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，其後居後列，走勢稚嫩。末段保持走勢，遠離外欄競跑。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Made contact shortly after start, raced better than midfield on the middle track in the early stages, peaked on run approaching 500M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，早段居中間之前位置，在跑道中央競跑。趨近五百米處時未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled okay, no clear run over the final 150M, could not be fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。走勢不俗。最後一百五十米未能望空，未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Towards rear of mid-field, headway into third 150m out, stayed on but no danger to front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。一百五十米處上前進佔第三位。保持走勢，但未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走外疊，沿途沒有遮擋。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Very slowly away, soon recovered to rear end of the field, in a similar position into straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘非常緩慢，瞬即回復走勢，居馬群後列。入直路時位置相若。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持走勢，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Always thereabouts settling one back on rail behind leader cum eventual winner over 800M out, fought on under pressure but unable to quicken to threaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 沿途居啣接位置。八百米處落後領放馬兼頭馬一個馬位，走內欄。在催策下力拼，但未能加速以構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, ridden along to lead, traveled comfortably, led all the way to score (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速。受催策，取得領先，走勢暢順。一放到底，取得勝利。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Began well, raced behind midfield on the stands' side, 3 to 4 lengths back in the middle stages, passed some tired runners final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，靠近外欄競跑。中段落後三至四個馬位。最後四百米超越部分已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, positioned 1-3/4L behind the leader on the inside, same position on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一又四分三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W) Tracked leading pair, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W) 跟隨領先兩駒。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Travelled one back 3-wide without cover, came to join the leader rounding home bend, faded steadily inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 落後一個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時追上領放馬。最後三百米逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Shared 5th about 3L off the pace on rail when checked and lost position 900M out, 4L back in 7th rounding home bend, no clear run early in straight and forced to check 300M out, produced some late impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 並居第五位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走內欄。九百米處勒避及失位。轉直路彎時居第七位，落後四個馬位。直路初未能望空。三百米處被迫勒避。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat in front of midfield, raced wide, gave ground quickly inside 150M (See Incident Report).
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。一百五十米處迅速墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, weakened and gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路上轉弱及墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled towards rear in 9th or 8th, switched wide for a run into straight, made short-lived effort at about the 200M, made no further impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列第八或第九位。入直路時移出外疊取位。約二百米處一度發力，末段再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, made ground along the rail.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段沿欄追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑及與對手互相碰撞，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Shifted in abruptly and bumped heavily out of stalls, raced wide in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 出閘時急促向內斜跑及發生大力碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat behind midfield, held up over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。末段受困。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Recovered from slow start to race in mid-field, stayed on final 200m but lacked pace to trouble front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置。最後二百米保持走勢，但速度不足以威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Slowly away, recovered to race in rear of mid-field, pushed along over 300m out, unable to quicken and no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後恢復走勢，居中間之後位置。三百米處受推策，但未能加速及構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, keen 900m out, ridden along 500m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。九百米處搶口。五百米處受催策。毫無表現。
