runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly and raced at the back, struggled to keep up with rivals middle stages, couldn't go on final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居後列。中段難以跟上對手。最後四百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in rear top of home straight, switched for clear run 300m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。末段未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, angled off rail 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處移離內欄。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, some headway on bend, sustained headway in home straight but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路彎略為追前。直路上持續上前，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W2W3W) Settled well back on the fence, moved off the rail in the middle stages, closed off fairly over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 遙居於後，走內欄。中段移離內欄。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Began awkwardly and made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide at rear, found rail 900M, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘笨拙，其後不久發生觸碰，居後列，走第二疊。九百米處移入內欄，直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處時未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, raced slightly better than midfield on the outside, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Taken well back from a poor draw, commenced move 3-wide rounding home bend, ran on well in straight despite not having much room at about the 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 自第十一檔出閘，遙居於後。轉直路彎時開始上前，走第三疊。直路上走勢良佳，但大約二百米處空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Moderately away from gate 1, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, 2 wide from 850M, same margin back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 自第一檔出閘普通，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。自八百五十米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Soon taken well back from a wide barrier travelling mainly 4-wide without cover, made headway towards rear inside the 850M, one of the widest into straight, ran home one-paced while hanging out under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置，大多走第四疊，沒有遮擋。八百五十米處略為追前至後列。入直路時為走最外疊的馬匹之一。末段保持同速，在催策下外閃。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Bumped start, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 起步時被碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, pressed leader, quickly lost place early in home straight, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞。追迫領放馬。直路初迅速失位。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) Sat outside lead, kept on until weakened final 100M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持走勢，直至最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced prominently on the inside, allowed rival to cross near 700M, sat right behind the leader on turn, bumped near 250M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居前列，走內疊。接近七百米處時讓對手超越。直路彎緊隨領放馬。接近二百五十米處時發生碰撞。以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled smoothly, switched out rounding the Turn, responded nicely under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走勢順暢。轉直路彎時向外移出。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Checked leaving stalls, four wide in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 出閘時勒避，居後列，走第四疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Raced in rear, driven along and outpaced from 700m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列。自七百米處起受催策，但未能跟上步速。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, unable to hold position halfway, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。半程時未能保持位置。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled behind midfield 3 wide, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Tracked pace against inside rail, chased winner from 300m out, unable to quite match that rival but stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 沿欄跟隨領放馬。自三百米處起追趕頭馬。末段未能追上頭馬，但保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Mid-field, good headway between horses to challenge 200m out, responded well and on top final 50m, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 居中間位置。二百米處在馬匹之間以佳勢上前展開挑戰。對催策反應良佳，最後五十米取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W) Waited with, still in rear top of home straight, stayed on final 200m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W) 留力候上。直路初仍居後列。最後二百米保持走勢，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Settled towards the rear on the rail, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Amongst leaders briefly from a wide draw and soon taken back to wide in last few, carried wider into home straight, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘，一度居領先馬匹之間，瞬即留後至最後數位之內，走外疊。入直路時被帶出更外疊，其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W4W) Began only fairly and made contact, positioned 5 lengths behind the leader on the inside, angled out 500M, same margin back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W4W) 出閘僅屬一般及發生觸碰，落後領放馬五個馬位，走內疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後相同距離。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W4W) Began well from gate 11, trapped wide in midfield, no cover throughout, weakened early in straight when hard run took toll. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W4W) 自第十一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。耗力太多，直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, showed some dash, run peaked final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。略為加速上前。最後七十五米未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Across to track leader, ridden along to chase leader 600m out, stayed on steadily but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 切入以跟隨領放馬。六百米處受催策，追趕領放馬。保持穩勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W2W2W) Ridden from the widest draw settling one back in 2nd 850M out, improved to take up running 440M out holding over 1L advantage into straight, kept on well under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策。八百五十米處居第二位，落後一個馬位。上前，四百四十米處取得領先。入直路時領先逾一個馬位。末段在催策下保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W2W) Tracked clear leader, gave chase from 400m out, overhauled that rival 100m out, ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W2W) 跟隨遙遙領先的領放馬。自四百米處起追趕領放馬。一百米處超越該駒。走勢強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W) Mid-field, under pressure 300m out, stayed on final 150m, couldn't quite reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處受催策。最後一百五十米保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 lengths or so back, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，落後約兩個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, raced keenly throughout, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。沿途搶口。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) One of quickest away from the stalls, raced keenly in the early stages, held up for a short distance early part of the straight, knuckled down to the task once clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘最快馬匹之一。早段搶口。直路早段在一段短途程上受困。末段望空後瞬即力拼上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced slightly behind midfield the inside, 5 lengths back turning in, made little progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Bounded as stalls opened and lost ground, in rear, good headway halfway out, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 出閘時向上跳躍及失地，居後列。半程時追前甚多。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W5W) Settled in mid-field, keen middle stages, commenced move out wide 600m out, bumped and lost balance 500m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W5W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。六百米處開始上前，走外疊。五百米處發生碰撞及失去平衡。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Raced wide, improved to press leader 900m out, pressed on 300m out, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 走外疊。九百米處上前追迫領放馬。三百米處受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, short of room early in home straight, switched for clear run 200m out, ran on well but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。直路初空位不足。二百米處轉換跑線以望空。走勢良佳，但未能威脅頭馬。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Kingman from Sidona, a daughter of Soldier Hollow. Horses by the same sire include Thesis and Fast Speed. He was given three trials in Hong Kong for one placing. He raced handily and finished third under a hold, beaten by 8-1/2Ls, over 1050m AWT at Sha Tin on June 5. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished fourth under slight pressure, beaten by 11-1/4Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on August 28. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「皇僕」(Kingman)之後，在港同父馬包括「論文」及「勁步速」等駒，生母出自「滑雪勝地」(Soldier Hollow)。抵港後三次試閘一次上名。6月5日出試田泥1050米，早段跟前，末段按韁下跑第三名，落後頭馬8.5個馬位。最近8月28日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第四名，落後頭馬11.25個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, held up last, ridden along 600m out, short of room 400m out to 200m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，留居包尾位置。六百米處受催策。四百米處至二百米處空位不足。最後二百米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W) Sat in front of midfield 3 wide with cover, ran on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。 末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W5W) Caught 3 wide no cover near midfield, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W5W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, keen early, ridden top of home straight, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，早段搶口。直路初受催策，掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Tracked pace, no extra and losing ground when becoming unbalanced 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;跟隨領放馬。五十米處在失去平衡之際再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走勢尚可。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Raced in touch, good headway to challenge leader 100m out, held final 50m but clear of remainder.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。以佳勢上前，一百米處挑戰領放馬。最後五十米落後，但拋離其他對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, angled out in the Straight, closed off nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居後列，走第二疊。直路上向外移出。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Soon taken back towards rear from a poor draw, travelled 3-wide around home bend and into straight, responded well inside final 300M to prevail near the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自第十三檔出閘後瞬即留居後列。轉直路彎及入直路時走第三疊。最後三百米對催策反應良佳，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W5W) Mid-field, keen mid-race, forward move 300m out, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W5W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。三百米處上前。保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Heavily bumped leaving stalls, keen under restraint, three wide in mid-field, short-lived challenge 400m out, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 出閘時發生大力碰撞。在約束下搶口，居中間位置，走第三疊。四百米處一度發力展開挑戰。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat on pace, unable to quickened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居前列。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Shifted out at start and made contact, positioned a length behind the leader, 2 away from the stands' rail, peaked on run 400M, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時向外斜跑及發生觸碰，落後領放馬一個馬位，走外欄第三疊。四百米處未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Led, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 領放。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Away awkwardly and settled prominent early, overraced early stages, lacked a finishing effort over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，早段居前列，搶口。末段衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Prominent early, gradually shifted back to worse than midfield in 9th, inconvenienced when tempo slackened 800M out, baulked until clear run 300M out near the centre of the track, ran on steadily to be nearest at finish
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 早段居前列，逐漸墮居中間之後的第九位。八百米處在步速減慢時受妨礙。受困直至三百米處望空，靠近跑道中央競跑。末段以穩勢追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Out with rest, raced behind midfield, nearer to the middle track, 4 lengths back in the middle stages, made no progress final 400M.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。中段落後四個馬位。最後四百米毫無進展。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled midfield one off the fence, one paced to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat midfield, responded well under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置。末段對鞭策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along on bend, tended to hang right in home straight, made up several places.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎受推策。直路上傾向內閃。末段追前數位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Bumped start, sent forward to take the lead, shared lead with rival on turn, peaked and headed 300M, weakened and eased thereafter.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，受催策上前帶頭。直路彎與對手並排領先。三百米處未能再增速及被超越。其後轉弱及收慢。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

raceinfo_eng.RaceName: THE TUNG WAH GROUP OF HOSPITALS CHALLENGE CUP (HANDICAP)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W4W) Reserved in midfield 6Ls off the steady pace, switched to 3-wide making the turn for home, quickened up impressively from 400M, led mid-straight before powering away to win by big margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W4W) 留居中間位置，落後步速平穩的領放馬六個馬位。轉直路彎時移至第三疊。自四百米處起加速凌厲。直路中段取得領先。其後帶離對手，大勝而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, angled out in the Straight, stayed on well, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。直路上向外移出。保持佳勢，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in last few, obtained a clear run 300M out, ran on well inside final 200M past beaten runners closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居最後數位之內。三百米處望空。最後二百米以佳勢上前。末段超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Sat midfield, traveled okay, switched out at the Turn, made steady progress when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走勢尚可。直路彎向外移出。在催策下以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide towards rear, 7 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Sat towards rear, directed out in the Straight, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 居後列。直路上向外移出。末段穩步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Sat near the rear on the rail, never seriously tested when held up early, made decent ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 居後列，走內欄。直路早段受困時未能真正施為。末段追前頗多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W2W4W) Sat rear, improved and switched out approaching the corner, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W2W4W) 居後列。趨近直路彎時推進及向外移出。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled towards rear, fought on steadily in home straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列。直路上持續力拼，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, only one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Raced in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Tracked pace, improved between horses to lead 200m out, in control final 50m, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。在馬匹之間推進，二百米處取得領先。最後五十米控制大局。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Crowded start, raced at rear on the outside, still 8 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走外疊。入直路時仍落後約八個馬位。直路上追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Ridden along to race prominently, raced wide throughout, stayed on well in home straight, lost out narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 在催策下居前列，沿途走外疊。直路上保持佳勢。以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced better than midfield on the outside, 1-1/2L back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Mid-field, one paced under pressure when short of room and forced to switch around 200m out, stayed on after, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，在催策下保持同速，空位不足。約二百米處被迫向外移出。其後保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide in front of midfield, raced greenly in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路上走勢稚嫩。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Travelled in midfield 3-wide with cover, slightly worse around home bend and given reminders entering straight, kept on under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。轉直路彎時稍為墮後，入直路時受鞭策。在催策下保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, forced to steady top of home straight, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路初被迫收慢。末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, held up early part of the Straight, ran on when in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受困。末段在望空下追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Prominent briefly and soon dropped to wide in worse than midfield, produced moderate short-lived effort early in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 一度居前列，瞬即墮居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路初一度發力，走勢普通。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，落後約五個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Sat midfield, traveled smoothly, switched out rounding the Turn, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居中間位置，走勢暢順。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, some headway on bend against rail, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。直路彎沿欄略為追前。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leader, ridden and outpaced 400m out, stayed on final 150m, tight for room between rivals closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處受催策，被拋離。最後一百五十米保持走勢。末段在馬匹之間受緊迫。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, closed off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat 3 wide behind midfield, closed off nicely, no threat to top 2.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Crowded at start settling in midfield, baulked briefly for a run over 350M out, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置。三百五十米處一度受困。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield, not much impression made (See Incident Report).
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置。無甚表現。（見競賽事件報告。）
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced behind midfield on the outside, 6-1/2L back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Sat towards rear, responded fairly well under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居後列。末段對鞭策反應不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Broke well from a wide barrier settling in midfield between runners, came under pressure to challenge upon straightening but did not find much room until inside the 200M, quickened well to snatch 2nd final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，在馬匹之間競跑。入直路時在催策下展開挑戰，但空位不足直至二百米處。以佳勢加速，最後數步跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Across from wide draw and raced outside of leader, took narrow lead 300m out, headed 200m out and no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後切入，居領放馬外側。三百米處以短距離領先。二百米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped in from wide draw, struggling in rear when checked 350m out, well held after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，向內移入。在後列掙扎上前，三百五十米處勒避，其後落後頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Began awkwardly, raced at tail, 7-3/4L back turning in, taken wide in straight and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居包尾位置。入直路時落後七又四分三個馬位。直路上移出外疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, raced in rear, ridden top of home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居後列。直路初受催策。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W6W) Bumped start, raced towards rear on the outside, no cover in the middle stages, very wide turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W6W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走外疊。中段沒有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced 2 wide at rear, moved closer on turn, 4Ls back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W4W) 自最外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。直路彎追近。入直路時落後四個馬位。衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W6W) Sat midfield 2 wide, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W6W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Sat in front of midfield, traveled nicely, slightly weakened passing the 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間之前位置。走勢良佳。跑過二百米處時略為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W2W) Began well from gate 10, raced 3 wide behind midfield, sent forward after passing 850M, took the lead near 600M, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight to hold off the challengers.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W2W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。跑過八百五十米處後受催策上前。接近六百米處時取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，力拒對手的挑戰勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W2W2W1W) Away well, positioned 2 wide, a length or so back, found rail near 550M, 1-1/2L back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W2W2W1W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。接近五百五十米處時移入內欄。入直路時落後一個半馬位，直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Sluggish start, three-wide without cover throughout, good headway on final bend, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 出閘緩慢，沿途走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎追前甚多。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Mid-field, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，自四百米處起受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, 2 wide from 900M, 6 lengths back in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。自九百米起走第二疊。中段落後六個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 450M, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。四百五十米處向外移出。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, headed over 300m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。三百米處被超越。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (3W2W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, kept on but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(3W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持走勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled fairly, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W1W) 居前列，走勢一般。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Settled on pace 2 wide, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon prominent, led after 400m, headed over 200m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 瞬即居前列。過了四百米處後領放。二百米處被超越，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W1W2W) Wide early from high draw, led after 400m, headed 600m out, remained prominent until no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W1W2W) 自外檔出閘，早段走外疊。跑了四百米後取得領先。六百米處被超越。仍居前列，直至最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W) Jumped ok, sat midfield one off the rail, hit the line strongly when asked, just missed by a whisker.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W) 出閘尚可，居中間位置，走第二疊。在催策下衝刺強勁，僅以短馬頭位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Began well from a middle draw, settled down 2-wide in midfield, lay in when placed under pressure in the home straight, ran to the line steadily for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 自第七檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上在催策下內閃。末段以穩勢上前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, driven 500m out, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, stayed on but unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策。未能望空直至一百五十米處。保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) A bit outpaced early and raced in last place, short of room when trying to improve 300m out, switched and ran on final 250m, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 早段略為未能跟上步速，居包尾位置。三百米處在嘗試推進時空位不足。最後二百五十米轉換跑線及追前，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced towards rear on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 10, raced behind midfield on outer, 5 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自第十檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Crowded shortly after start losing ground, soon recovered to 9th towards rear on rail, forced to steady when pace slackened onto first turn, made no impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫及失地，瞬即恢復走勢，居後列第九位，走內欄。進入首個彎位步速減慢時被迫收慢。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 9, raced 3 wide with cover towards rear, moved a bit closer on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 自第九檔出閘，留居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎略為追近。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled at the rear early, moved closer to midfield passing 800M, held up 400M to 300M before closing off fairly. No threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，早段居後列。跑過八百米處時追近至中間位置。四百米處至三百米處之間受困，其後衝刺一般，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Slowly away, made up some ground to race rear of mid-field, under pressure 500m out, bumped between rivals 200m out, no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘緩慢，略為追前以居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策。二百米處在對手之間發生碰撞。未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat at the rear, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Never better than midfield, soon faded after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 從未超越中間位置。入直路後瞬即力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began only fairly, raced at rear on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, made very good progress in straight to take 2nd, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑入亞席，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in last few from a poor draw, baulked for a run after straightening until 300M out, only passed well-beaten runners.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後居最後數位之內。入直路後受困直至三百米處。僅能超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began moderately but soon picked up on rail to midfield, remained similar into straight, kept on until finding no extra inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，但瞬即沿欄加速上前，進佔中間位置。入直路時仍居相若位置。保持走勢，直至最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Taken back after the start, settled at the back 7-8Ls off the pace, still plenty to do 400M, finished off well making good progress to take 4th close home
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 起步後留居後列，落後領放馬七至八個馬位。四百米處仍落後甚多。衝刺良佳，追前甚多，接近終點時取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat at the rear, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, held up top of the Straight, never impress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路初受困，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Waited with in rear, keen to halfway, angled wide for a run early in home straight, stayed on late but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。半程前搶口。直路早段移出外疊取位。末段保持走勢，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled within 2L of pace in 3rd on the rail, saved ground turning in for home but unable to sustain effort shortly upon straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居第三位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，走內欄。入直路時走內欄節省腳程，但入直路後不久無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W1W1W) Won early battle for lead and set good pace, headed 150m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W1W1W) 早段取得領先，以快步速領放。一百五十米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) In rear after impeded leaving stalls, dropped to last place 500m out, ran on strongly final 200m to pass plenty of field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘時受阻礙，其後居後列。五百米處墮居包尾位置。最後二百米以勁勢追前，超越多駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sent forward to be prominent 3 wide, kept on only fairly. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 受催策上前，居前列，走第三疊。末段僅能保持一般走勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Jumped well from gate 12, raced prominently on the outside, slightly taken back after passing 1200M, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths back in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。跑過千二米處後稍為留後，走第二疊。中段落後兩個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W5W) Jumped awkwardly and then checked briefly, in rear, very wide and pushed along turning into home straight, no response.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W5W) 出閘笨拙，其後一度勒避，居後列，走大外疊。轉入直路時受推策，毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Sat in front of midfield 3 wide, under pressure from the 550M, gave ground soon after.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊。自五百五十米處起受催策，其後瞬即墮退。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled some 3L off the pace in 5th or 6th on rail, drifted slightly further back passing the 1000M coming onto home bend, saved ground making final turn but soon weakened after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居第五或第六位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走內欄。跑過一千米處開始轉直路彎時稍微墮後。轉直路彎時走內欄節省腳程。但入直路後瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Raced rear, never traveled, eased down entering the Straight (Unacceptable Performance, Must BT, See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 居後列。沿途走勢欠順。入直路時收慢。（表現難以接受。必須試閘及格。見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, held up top of the Straight, made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路初受困。略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, unable to slot in, raced 4 wide behind midfield early, moved a bit closer after passing 1000M, positioned 3 wide better than midfield on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，未能切入內疊，早段居中間之後位置，走第四疊。跑過一千米處後略為追近，直路彎居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Mid-field, didn't travel with much fluency, outpaced and left behind home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走勢欠順。直路上未能跟上步速及被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Caught very wide without cover on pace, stuck on well despite the tough run.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居前列，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。儘管多走腳程，但保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled in rear of midfield, slightly worse into home straight, inconvenienced over 250M out, kept on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時略為墮後。二百五十米處受妨礙，末段保持穩勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, travelled keenly in the middle stages, made contact 700M, 3 lengths back turning in, finished off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走第二疊。中段搶口。七百米處發生觸碰。入直路時落後三個馬位。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) From draw 13 caught racing wide without cover in midfield, fought on under top weight in the home straight, just missed 3rd in a busy finish for the minor placings.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自第十三檔出閘後居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上在負頂磅下力拼。在多駒爭取入位下僅失季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W) Settled midfield on rail, navigated through traffic, ran on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。在馬匹之間穿插上前。末段走勢強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W5W) Jumped only fairly and made contact, raced 3 wide with cover towards rear, wider from 700M, moved closer on turn, finished off strongly to take 2nd, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，與對手互相觸碰。居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。自七百米處起走更外疊。直路彎追近。衝刺強勁，取得亞軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Mid-field, chased winner home from 300m out, clear of rest but unable to close gap on winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。自三百米處起追趕頭馬。拋離餘駒，但未能收窄與頭馬的距離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sat in front of midfield early, hampered at the 800M and shuffled towards the rear, ran on fairly afterwards.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 早段居中間之前位置。八百米處受阻礙，墮居後列。其後走勢一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Showed speed to get across, headed by rivals top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 展現前速以切入內疊。直路初被對手超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled 3 wide near midfield, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊。在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, pressured for lead and one of three that raced clear to halfway, headed over 200m out, weakened, eased final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 帶頭競跑。在催策下保持領先位置，為半程前拋離馬群的三駒之一。二百米處被超越，轉弱。最後五十米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 200M, finished 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後二百米未能抗衡頭馬，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, raced prominently, took the lead near 1250M, led by a length in the middle stages, kept on well in straight, shifted out abruptly 100M, always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列。接近一千二百五十米處時取得領先。中段領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢。一百米處急促向外斜跑。保持領放至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began well, raced in 2nd, 1-3/4L back turning in, hit the front 200M, peaked and headed 150M, stayed on evenly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居第二位。入直路時落後一又四分三個馬位。二百米處取得領先。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。末段保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Chased the leader, traveled fairly, briefly held up inside 200M, closed off fairly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。走勢一般。二百米處一度受困。末段衝刺一般。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, ridden along 600m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。六百米處受催策。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, switched out in the Straight, ran on nicely, just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路上向外移出。末段以佳勢上前，僅保住冠軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, struggled to hold position on bend, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎難以保持位置。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced wide in mid-field, headway into contention 200m out, stayed on between horses despite being tight for room.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。二百米處上前爭勝。儘管在馬匹之間受緊迫，但保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed very good response in straight, took the lead approaching 150M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
(Lost left hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上對催策反應甚佳。趨近一百五十米處時取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點。從容取勝。
（失去左後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced at rear, saved ground on turn, no daylight early in straight, made good progress after passing 300M, no clear run towards finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初未能望空。跑過三百米處後追前甚多。末段未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Pressed leader, took narrow lead over 300m out, headed 200m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。三百米處以短距離領先。二百米處被超越。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well before being restrained to a midfield position 4-5Ls off the pace, fought on steadily final 400M but was always held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，其後受約束，居中間位置，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。最後四百米持續力拼，但一直落後領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, ended up racing at the rear group, had some work to do top of the straight but couldn't quicken enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列。直路初仍落後頗遠，但加速力不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Raced in rear, headway out wide 800m out, ridden 400m out, ran on well but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 居後列。八百米處追前，走外疊。四百米處受催策，以佳勢上前，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W4W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, angled out 550M, 3 lengths back turning in, made contact near 350M, ran on evenly to 150M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W4W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。五百五十米處向外移出。入直路時落後三個馬位。接近三百五十米處時發生觸碰。保持穩勢至一百五十米處，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Sat outside lead, kept on okay, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持不俗走勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Heavily bumped and lost balance shortly after start, raced in touch with leaders, good headway halfway out, ran on well to close on leaders but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步後不久被大力碰撞，失去平衡，跟隨領先馬匹。半程時以佳勢上前。走勢良佳，追近領先馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; In rear after awkward start, never any room to open up from 300m out, coasted past a few rivals final 150m, never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙，其後居後列。自三百米處起從未能望空。最後一百五十米輕鬆超越數匹對手。從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, made minor ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Settled behind midfield, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled in mid-field, unable to hold position by halfway, bumped 300m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。半程起未能保持位置。三百米處與對手互相碰撞。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled towards the rear, in similar position turning for home, ran home only fairly. Never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列。轉直路彎時位置相若。末段衝刺僅屬一般。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, pushed along 500m out, ran green, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。五百米處受推策，走勢稚嫩，超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Fast into stride, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the stands' rail, hard ridden approaching 300M, kept on well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;展步迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走外欄。趨近三百米處時受力策。保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W5W) 自大外檔出閘後留後，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊，直路上追前頗多，取得第四名，未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W) Slotted into a 3-wide spot behind midfield, closed off steadily final 300M to take 3rd but was readily held by first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。最後三百米衝刺平穩，跑獲季軍，但一直落後頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Mid-field, one paced under pressure, unable to make any impression on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持同速，未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Briefly hampered shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, under pressure 600m out to chase leaders, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 起步後不久一度受阻礙，居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處受催策以追趕領先馬匹。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, switched for clear run 300m out, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。三百米處向外移出以望空。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W1W) Shifted in at start and made contact, sent forward to take the lead, peaked and headed 350M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W1W) 起步時向內斜跑及發生觸碰，受催策上前取得領先。三百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began well from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, headed 200M, retook the lead 50M, kept on well but unable to hold off the challenger late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個半馬位。二百米處被超越。五十米處重奪領先位置。末段保持佳勢，但未能抗衡對手的挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Driven to take early lead, sat back in 3rd making the home turn, had difficulty obtaining clear running 300M before finishing off steadily to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 受催策，早段領放。轉直路彎時留居第三位。三百米處難以望空。其後衝刺平穩，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away awkwardly, reserved behind midfield along the inside, couldn't quicken passing 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，留居中間之後位置，走內疊。跑過四百米處時未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Always rear, forced to check 900M out dropping to last, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 一直居後列。九百米處被迫勒避，墮居包尾位置。再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Wide in mid-field, headway 400m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。四百米處追前。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sluggish start, shifted in and bumped out of stalls, in rear, good headway 500m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘緩慢，向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居後列。五百米處追前甚多，但未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Towards rear, pushed along when checked briefly 500m out, struggling and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列。五百米處受推策，一度勒避。最後三百米掙扎上前及被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Held up last, still in last pair top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居最後兩位之內。欠缺速度以展開挑戰。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Began only fairly, ended up racing near last, had some work to do 400M but responded only fairly to pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居接近包尾位置。四百米處落後頗遠，但對催策反應僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Soon taken back from a wide barrier, trailed the field from about 1300M out, made modest progress past well-beaten horses in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自最外檔出閘，瞬即留後。自約千三米處起尾隨馬群。直路上略為追前，超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded on jumping, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out after turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 躍出時受擠迫，居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後向外移出。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) In rear after sluggish start, under pressure 500m out, switched inside for clear run 350m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 起步緩慢，其後居後列。五百米處受催策。三百五十米處向內移入以望空。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Waited with towards rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide behind midfield, moved a bit closer after passing 700M, 3 wide on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。過了七百米處後略為追近。直路彎走第三疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, three wide in rear of mid-field, commenced move out wide 550m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。五百五十米處開始上前，走外疊。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W2W2W) Hampered leaving stalls, mid-field, keen mid-race, pushed along 300m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W2W2W) 出閘時受阻礙，居中間位置。中段搶口。三百米處受推策，末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W4W) Sat towards rear, switched out rounding the Turn, could not make ground (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W4W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W2W) Ridden along from wide draw to press leader, pushed along on bend to chase leader, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，在催策下追迫領放馬。直路彎受推策以追趕領放馬。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, forced to steady 500m out to avoid a rival that was giving ground, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。五百米處被迫收慢避開一匹正在墮退的對手。入直路時受推策，走外疊。以勁勢上前，一百米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Held up from high draw, bumped turning into home straight, stayed on at the one pace, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留後。轉入直路時發生碰撞。保持同速，從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, in control final 100m, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。最後一百米控制大局。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, stayed on well, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路初加速，取得領先，保持佳勢。被亞軍馬匹追迫至終點，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, under pressure to hold position 500m out, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策以保持位置。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact at start, raced behind midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之後位置。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Out in line, raced 2 wide in midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Began well from a wide draw, took the early lead, headed 1150M, allowed rival to cross near 950M, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths back in the middle stages, peaked 300M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，早段取得領先。一千一百五十米處被超越。接近九百五十米處時讓對手過頭。中段落後兩個馬位，走第二疊。三百米處未能再加速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先四分三馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Bumped out of stalls, raced in rear, driven along 500m out, switched for clear run 200m out, lacked pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，居後列。五百米處受催策。二百米處轉移跑線以望空，但缺乏速度。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled handy, gave ground rounding the Turn, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列。轉直路彎時墮退。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat midfield 3 wide, gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) In touch with leaders, pushed along 300m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受推策，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Began well from gate 13, positioned a length behind the leader on the stands' side, no clear run until final 50M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;自第十三檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位，走外欄。未能望空直至五十米處。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderately away, sent forward to take the lead, led by 4 lengths turning in, kicked clear early in straight, kept on very well, easily scored, very impressive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四個馬位。直路早段加速帶離。末段保持甚佳走勢，輕鬆掄元，表現出色。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jostled at start, gradually settled well back, commenced move inside the 400M and ran on well to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時受擠碰，逐漸遙居於後。四百米處開始上前，走勢良佳，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sluggish start, mid division, ridden along 400m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步緩慢，居中間位置。四百米處受催策。保持走勢，但未能增速以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat one off the rail alongside the leader, kept on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居領放馬旁側，走外欄第二疊。末段保持勁勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) Sat near the rear near center, held up until 350M, made good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)居後列，靠近跑道中央競跑。受困直至三百五十米處。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Tracked pace, under pressure 400m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;跟隨領放馬。四百米處受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Bumped at the start and tracked pace, passed tired lead pair, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;起步時發生碰撞，跟隨領放馬。超越已呈疲態的領先兩駒。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; From draw 13 tracked leaders along the stand rail, put in an honest effort chasing winner from 400M but was comfortably held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自第十三檔出閘，跟隨領先馬匹，走外欄。自四百米處起追趕頭馬，但未能追近該駒。演出穩健。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, taken wider 900m out, shifted right in home straight, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。九百米處被帶出更外疊。直路上向內斜跑。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W2W3W) Went forward under 10lb claimer and held the lead first turn, settled in 2nd from 1100M, fought hard to stay in contention early straight before weakening 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W2W3W) 在獲讓十磅的見習騎師策騎下上前，首個彎位取得領先。自千一米處起居第二位。直路初力拼以保持爭逐機會。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden early in home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W3W5W) Settled behind midfield 3-wide, pace very slow in the first half of the race, couldn't improve position when driven along home turn, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。賽事前半段步速非常緩慢，直路彎受催策時未能追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W4W5W) Bumped start, raced towards rear on the outside, 8 lengths or so back turning in, made very good progress in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W4W5W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W2W) Stumbled leaving stalls and lost balance, rail position in mid-field, switched for clear run 400m out and bumped, strong run to lead 300m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘時失蹄，失去平衡，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處向外移出以望空，與對手互相碰撞。走勢強勁，三百米處帶頭。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W5W) Moderately away, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, 4 wide from 750M, 4 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W5W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。自七百五十米處起走第四疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in worse than midfield and waited with, obtained a run just over 200M out and quickened well to snatch victory final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置，留力候上。就在過了二百米處後取得空位上前。以佳勢加速，最後數步取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; From draw 1 raced behind midfield towards the outside of the group, ran on one paced final 400M posing little threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自第一檔出閘後居中間之後位置，靠近馬群外側競跑。最後四百米保持同速，對領先馬匹威脅不大。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along towards centre of course 400m out, bumped 300m out, strong run to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置。四百米處受推策，在跑道中央競跑。三百米處發生碰撞。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先，其後保持領先，勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, rear of mid-field, briefly hampered 100m out, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑，發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。一百米處一度受阻礙，掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) In 4th spot always close enough to leaders, moved up to challenge for the lead passing 300M, no match for winner's pace final 200M. Finished clear 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 居第四位，沿途緊隨領先馬匹。跑過三百米處時上前爭奪領先。最後二百米加速力不及頭馬。跑獲亞軍，拋離餘駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Jumped on terms, up with pace early stages before easing back to a trailing spot behind leaders, fought hard in the straight but couldn't muster the pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 與對手同步出閘。早段跟上步速，其後收慢留居領先馬匹之後，有遮擋。直路上力拼，但未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W2W) Jumped well to race 3rd the rail, travelled smoothly, lifted strongly to win by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W2W) 出閘迅速，居第三位，走內欄。走勢暢順。衝刺強勁，以短距離之先獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Held up in mid-pack along the inside, lay in for most part of the straight, gave limited response only.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 留居中間位置，走內疊。直路上大部分途程內閃，對催策反應僅屬平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W1W1W) From wide draw taken across behind runners, raced at the rear along the inside, was finishing well but got held up between 150M-50M. Would have finished closer.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘，在馬群之後切入，居後列，走內疊。衝刺良佳，但一百五十米處至五十米處之間受困。本應可跑得更為接近。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off very strongly, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，衝刺凌厲，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 6 to 7 lengths back, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run until final 50M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置，落後六至七個馬位。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至最後五十米，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W2W) Settled in mid-division 2-wide 4Ls off the pace, little change in position home turn, fought on steadily final 300M, claimed 4th in a blanket finish for the minor placings.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W2W) 居中間位置，落後領放馬四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎位置相若。最後三百米持續力拼。在多駒爭入位置下取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Held narrow running early stages, some 1L off the pace on stands rail onto course proper, held every chance inside final 200M but unable to sustain effort close to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;早段以短距離領先。跑離分支直路時落後領放馬約一個馬位，走外欄。最後二百米一度甚具爭勝機會，但接近終點時無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden to narrow lead well off the rail from the 4 draw before settling 2-wide as joint leader 800M out, held position under pressure early in straight until swamped inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第四檔出閘，受催策，以短距離領先，走外疊。八百米處並排領先，走第二疊。直路早段在催策下保持位置，最後一百五十米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped awkwardly, soon in a prominent position racing down the center of track, couldn't quicken as well as the leaders final 200M. Comfortably held in 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙，瞬即居前列，在跑道中央競跑。最後二百米加速力不及領先馬匹。未能追近，取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Tracked pace, raced towards centre of course, pushed along 400m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;跟隨領放馬，在跑道中央競跑。四百米處受推策。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) Across to press leader, challenged leader turning into home straight, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 切入追迫領放馬。入直路時挑戰領放馬。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) Showed customary early speed to lead, kept going well passing 300M, was strongly challenged by rival late stages but managed to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 展現一貫前速，帶頭。跑過三百米處時保持佳勢。末段受對手強勁挑戰，但成功保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Moved up to press leader on outside, kept on well in the straight and led nearing 200M, couldn't hold off winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 上前追迫領放馬，走外疊。直路上保持佳勢。接近二百米處時領先。末段不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Ridden from moderate start from a wide barrier before settling just worse than midfield, found nothing under pressure in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，受催策，居中間稍後位置。直路上對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw and settled near last 6Ls off the pace, gave limited response in the straight. Never threatened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘，留居接近包尾位置，落後領放馬六個馬位。直路上對催策反應平平。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W3W5W) Caught racing wide without cover in midfield, failed to respond when placed under pressure 350M, eased when final 200M.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。三百五十米處對催策毫無反應。最後二百米收慢。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped fairly, gradually recovered to one-out-one-back in 3rd travelling keenly at times, some 3L back making home bend, made modest headway in straight while shifting ground early on to just fail to reach 2nd on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，逐漸恢復走勢，居第三位，落後一個馬位，走第二疊。不時搶口。轉直路彎時落後約三個馬位。直路早段斜跑，其後在直路上略為上前，僅未能在終點線上進佔亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Ridden to take up running over 800M out, led on stands rail until finding no extra 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;受催策，八百米處取得領先。沿外欄領放，一百五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the stands' side, ridden after passing 300M but only showed limited response, no clear run near 100M, one-paced thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，靠近外欄競跑。跑過三百米處後受催策，但反應僅屬平平。接近一百米處時未能望空，其後保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled just behind leaders 2 off the stand's rail, ran on nicely when asked, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居領先馬匹稍後位置，走外欄第三疊。在催策下走勢良佳，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Soon dropped to the rear, produced late impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;瞬即墮居後列。末段略為上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Close up to leaders early before settling behind mid-pack in middle stages, stayed on steadily final 200M under big weight but never troubled leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;早段緊隨領先馬匹，其後於中段居中間之後位置。最後二百米在負重磅下保持穩勢，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide towards rear, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Driven along and outpaced early stages, briefly short of room 350m out, ran on strongly final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。三百五十米處一度空位不足。最後一百米衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W4W) Away well but restrained early to be last in the field, ran past a few tired rivals in the final stages (See Incident Report).
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘迅速，但早段受約束，居包尾位置。末段超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, travelled smoothly, closed off nicely, just no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。走勢暢順。衝刺良佳，僅未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Sat towards rear, traveled nicely, switched out rounding the Turn, responded well under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居後列。走勢良佳。轉直路彎時向外移出。在鞭策下反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) In rear after awkward start, had to wait for run turning into home straight, hung right in home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。直路上內閃。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, tracked pace towards centre of course, effort 400m out, gave ground final 200m.
(Laceration to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞。在跑道中央跟隨領放馬。四百米處發力。最後二百米墮退。
（右後腿割傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Clean jump, took the lead, led by 1-1/2L in the middle stages, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘俐落，取得領先。中段領先一個半馬位。保持佳勢至終點，取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, chased leaders into home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield, raced keenly in the middle stages, responded nicely when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置。中段搶口。對催策反應良佳。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Disputed lead, led outright 300m out, soon challenged by winner, found that rival too strong final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 爭奪領先。三百米處單騎領放，瞬即被頭馬挑戰，最後一百五十米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W7W) Showed speed to get across, ran green, ran out abruptly 550m out and lost ground, strong run in home straight, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W7W) 展現前速，切入內疊。走勢稚嫩。五百五十米處急促向外斜跑，失地。直路上走勢強勁，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Pressed leader, under pressure 500m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
(Epiglottic entrapment.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;追迫領放馬。五百米處受催策。最後二百米迅速墮退。
（會厭被覆蓋。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat in front of midfield 3 off the outside rail, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間之前位置，走外欄第四疊。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Jumped nicely and shared lead, stuck on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;出閘迅速，並排領先。保持普通走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Broke well from poor draw settling 3-wide without cover in 4th about 1L off the pace, came to join the leader on top of home bend sharing lead into straight, unable to sustain effort and weakened under pressure inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居第四位，落後領放馬約一個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎早段追上領放馬。入直路時並排領先，但無以為繼，最後三百米在催策下轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced prominently, 2 wide, travelled keenly in the early and middle stages, 3/4L back turning in, showed no response early in straight, weakened and eased thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居前列，走第二疊。早段及中段搶口。入直路時落後四分三馬位。直路早段對催策毫無反應，其後轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped start, raced prominently on the stands' rail, took the lead 300M, kept on very well to hold off the challengers.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時發生碰撞，居前列，走外欄。三百米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢力拒對手的挑戰。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by I Am Invincible from Jalan Jalan, a daughter of Foreplay. Horses by the same sire include Invincible Shield and Pi Legend. This fellow had three starts in Australia for one win (a 3yo+ maiden over 1200m). He was given four trials in Hong Kong for one win and one placing. He shared the lead and won under pressure, by 1-1/4Ls, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on June 8. In the latest trial, he sat not far from the pace and finished fourth under slight pressure, beaten by 1-1/4Ls, over 800m on turf in Conghua on August 31. He looks a nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「至高無極」(I Am Invincible)之後，在港同父馬包括「笑傲江湖」及「偵探傳奇」等駒，生母出自「前奏」(Foreplay)。來港前於澳洲三戰得一勝，該場為1200米三歲及以上從未勝出馬賽。抵港後試閘四次得一勝一位。6月8日出試從化草地1000米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下以1.25個馬位之先勝出。最近8月31日出試從化草地800米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段稍騎下跑第四名，落後頭馬1.25個馬位。潛質不俗，初出預計會有良好走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Waited with towards rear, switched wide for clear run top of home straight, bumped 150m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初移出外疊以望空。一百五十米處與對手互相碰撞。末段保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped fairly, moved up to settle just off leaders, responded well to pressure 300M challenging for the lead, peaked on his run passing 100M and outsprinted by first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘一般，上前居領先馬匹稍後位置。三百米處對催策反應良佳，爭奪領先。跑過一百米處時未能再增速，被首兩名馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Never far off from a middle draw, came under pressure to challenge inside final 300M holding every chance, only to be outsprinted close to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自中檔出閘後從未遠離領先馬匹。最後三百米受催策以展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會，僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; From draw 14 went forward to be racing with leaders, responded well up the stand's rail final 200M, just denied.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自第十四檔出閘，上前與領先馬匹並跑。最後二百米沿外欄競跑時對催策反應良佳。僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Prominent, improved to lead 500m out, pressed on 350m out, headed by winner 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居前列。推進上前，五百米處取得領先。三百五十米處受追迫。一百米處被頭馬超越。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened final 50M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W1W) 受催策上前帶頭。保持走勢，最後五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat on pace on the stands' rail, ran on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居前列，走外欄。走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat last, stayed on late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居包尾位置。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Bumped start, raced at rear throughout, never a factor. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Waited with towards rear, struggled to hold position from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。自四百米處起難以保持位置。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Maintained a position in midfield, came under pressure home turn and dropped away on straightening. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路彎受催策。入直路時墮退。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat behind the leaders on the rail, kept on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (6W3W3W) Began well from gate 10, trapped very wide in midfield early, moved a bit closer after passing 850M, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(6W3W3W) 自第十檔出閘迅速。早段居中間位置，走大外疊。跑過八百五十米處後略為追近。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W2W2W) Sent forward to be racing outside the lead, struggled to keep up 350M, gave ground rapidly mid-straight. (Jockey - racing wide without cover the principal reason for its disappointing run.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W2W2W) 受催策上前，居領放馬外側。三百五十米處難以跟上對手。直路中段迅速墮退。（騎師表示，坐騎在沒有遮擋下走外疊是表現令人失望的主因。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on rail, crowded near 550M, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走內欄。接近五百五十米處時受擠迫，直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled nicely, raced in restricted room over the concluding stages, closed off reasonably well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 跟前競跑，走勢良佳。末段在窄位競跑。衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Made all, keen under restraint, kicked early in home straight and ran on well, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 一放到底。在約束下搶口。直路早段加速，走勢良佳。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly, obtained a midfield position along the inside, brought wide 300M to find clear running but responded only fairly. (Jockey - didn't travel well during the event and changed stride on a number of occasions.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走內疊。三百米處移出外疊以望空，但對催策反應僅屬一般。（騎師表示，坐騎沿途走勢欠佳，數度轉腳。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Moderately away, raced better than midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 600M, 1-3/4L back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。跑過六百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後一又四分三個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace, traveled comfortably, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列。走勢暢順。衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Pressed forward from a wide draw to lead about 1000M out, obtained rails run in front onto first turn and steadied up pace, headed briefly on straightening but soon re-gained advantage only to be worn down again over 100M out.
