runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前，約一千米處取得領先。開始轉首個彎位時移入內欄領放，減慢步速。入直路時一度被超越，但瞬即再度領先。僅在一百米處再度被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Broke well from the widest draw, well there and wide before taking up running about 900M out, obtained rails run onto home bend, just under 1L in front on straightening, kept on under pressure but pipped at post.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居好位，走外疊。約九百米處取得領先。開始轉直路彎時移入內欄。入直路時領先近一個馬位，在催策下保持走勢，但過終點時僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled just off the pace in 5th, responded well to pressure 400M and moved to 2nd 250M, fought hard but peaked on its run 150M from home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居領放馬稍後的第五位。四百米處對催策反應良佳。二百五十米處進佔第二位。力拼，但一百五十米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced wide without cover throughout, improved to press leader 700m out, pressed on 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 沿途在沒有遮擋下走外疊。七百米處推進以追迫領放馬。三百米處受催策，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Across to press leader, pushed along to chase leader top of home straight, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 切入追迫領放馬。直路初受推策，追趕領放馬。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W3W) Tracked leaders, pushed along 450m out to chase leaders, unable to match winner but stayed on steadily, lost second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百五十米處受推策，追趕領先馬匹。未能追上頭馬，但保持穩勢。末段失去亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away in line, stayed close enough to leaders, moved up to 2nd top of straight, responded well to take lead near 200M but couldn't hold off winner final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，保持落後領先馬匹不遠。直路初上前進佔第二位。對催策反應良佳，接近二百米處時取得領先，但末段未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) From wide draw crossed to race in a 2-wide spot just off leaders, responded well leaving the bend to be challenging for the lead mid-straight, hard driven final 200M and only went down by a neck . Game in defeat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，切入第二疊，緊隨領先馬匹。離開直路彎時對催策反應良佳。直路中段爭奪領先。最後二百米受力策，在力拼下僅以一馬頸位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled ahead of midfield, disadvantaged by racing wide without cover throughout, responded fairly when asked in the straight and couldn't get closer to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置。沿途在沒有遮擋下走外疊，不利發揮。直路上對催策反應一般。未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders, well placed into home straight, strong run to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W) 出閘時向外斜跑及碰撞對手，跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。以勁勢上前，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, keen 1100m out, short of room early in home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。千一米處搶口。直路早段空位不足。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, short-lived effort top of home straight, no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。直路初一度發力。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Guided to a rail spot in second half of the field, saved ground throughout the event, quickened up nicely passing 350M, led near 50M winning determinedly.
(Sustained a wound to the right knee.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a wound to the right knee.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 留居後半馬群中，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。跑過三百五十米處時加速良佳。接近五十米處時取得領先，在力拼下掄元。
（右膝有傷口。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Badly crowded and bumped at start, settled in rear of mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 起步時嚴重受擠迫，被碰撞。居中間之後位置。未能望空直至二百米處。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Chased leaders on the inside, fought on well enough passing 350M but was always held by first two final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 追趕領先馬匹，走內疊。跑過三百五十米處時以頗佳走勢力拼，但最後二百米一直落後頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W4W) Waited with in rear, keen middle stages, pushed along widest into home straight, hung in but ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。中段搶口。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。內閃，但最後二百米走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W2W) Held up last, still in last place and plenty to do top of home straight, ran on strongly final 200m to lead close home, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置，落後甚遠。最後二百米走勢強勁，接近終點時取得領先。帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in rear, unable to secure clear run until 350m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。未能望空直至三百五十米處，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, pushed along to chase leaders 500m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受推策，追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, tight for room top of home straight, ran on well to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路初受緊迫。走勢良佳，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) From a wide draw slotted into a 2-wide spot in midfield, brought wide 400M to challenge, finished off best final 200M to take 3rd close home. Nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。四百米處移出外疊以展開挑戰。最後二百米衝刺最佳，接近終點時取得第三名。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Caught racing wide no cover in midfield in the early and middle stages, moved up to join leaders passing 600M, hit lead 300M out but proved no match for winner from mid-straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 早段及中段居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。上前，跑過六百米處時追上領先馬匹。三百米處取得領先，但自直路中段起不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 500m out to chase leaders, ran on well to lead 100m out, pressed by runner-up to line and just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。以佳勢上前，一百米處取得領先。被亞軍馬匹追迫至終點，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W4W) Dropped back to the rear and stayed 3-wide 8Ls off leader, ran past beaten horses in the straight and not getting to leaders. (Jockey satisfied with the finishing effort, particularly as it was dropping back in distance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W4W) 墮居後列，落後領放馬八個馬位，走第三疊。直路上超越已洩氣的對手，但未能追及領先馬匹。（騎師對坐騎衝刺時的走勢感到滿意，尤其坐騎自上仗縮程。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Led on rail early. Weakened at 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 早段沿欄領放。五十米力弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Stayed close to leaders, raced keenly in the middle stages when pace was steadied, briefly held up for clear running 400M but couldn't go on afterwards.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 保持緊隨領先馬匹。中段在步速減慢時搶口。四百米處一度受困而未能望空，但其後無以為繼。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped well from draw 1 and sat in 3rd, had difficulty obtaining clear running passing for some distance passing 250M but the finishing response was only when fair late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居第三位。跑過二百五十米處時在一段途程上難以望空，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W3W) From draw 1 stayed close enough to leaders, was repeatedly denied for clear running in the home straight before easing off final 150M when no chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W3W) 自第一檔出閘，保持緊隨領先馬匹。直路上一再未能望空。最後一百五十米在再無爭逐機會下收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Quickly into stride, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L on turn, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎領先四分三馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced prominently on the outside, took the lead near 1150M, found rail near 950M, led by a length turning in, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居前列，走外疊。接近一千一百五十米處時取得領先。接近九百五十米處切入內欄。入直路時領先一個馬位。保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Slightly slow out, gradually recovered along the rail to just over 1L back in 3rd, angled out for a run entering straight, found nothing.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，逐漸恢復走勢，居第三位，落後稍逾一個馬位，走內欄。入直路時向外移出取位，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, without cover halfway out, taken wider on bend, eased 350m out when jockey was concerned with his action.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。半程時沒有遮擋。直路彎移出更外疊。三百五十米處在騎師對坐騎的動作有疑慮之際收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, made good ground early part of the Straight, just one pace late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路早段追前甚多，但末段僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover midfield, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Crowded on jumping from a wide draw then taken back to race at the rear, ran on fairly without threat to the leaders. Had difficulty obtaining clear running near 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 自外檔出閘時受擠迫，其後留居後列。走勢一般，未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。接近一百米處時難以望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off okay, peaked at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。衝刺不俗，一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Travelled keenly in rear of midfield on rail, pulled closer rounding home bend sharing 6th into straight, kept on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄，搶口。轉直路彎時追近，入直路時並列第六位。保持穩勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled in last few on rail, remained similar into straight, improving well when baulked 200M out, renewed effort when clear for a run just over 100M out, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居最後數位之內，走內欄。入直路時居相若位置。以佳勢上前，但二百米處受困。就在過了一百米處後望空時重新發力，末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, driven along 600m out, outpaced and left behind final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。六百米處受催策。最後二百五十米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Shifted in and heavily bumped out of stalls, waited with towards rear, under pressure 700m out, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑，發生大力碰撞。居後列，留力候上。七百米處受催策，末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, challenged up rail from 200m out, stayed on but no match for leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時須等待空位出現。自二百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。末段保持走勢，但不敵領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Taken back to race towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run until 150M, made some progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至一百五十米處，其後略為追前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Awkward start, three wide in rear of mid-field, taken wider on bend, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路彎移出較外疊。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled towards the rear on the rail, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, closed off nicely, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 500M, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame without threatening the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, recovered to race in midfield along the fence, 4Ls behind leader 400M, ran on steadily for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，其後恢後走勢，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處落後領放馬四個馬位。以穩勢追前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, keen early stages, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上，早段搶口。入直路時受推策，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crowded start, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, no clear run in the Straight, never tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。直路上未能望空。從未能施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, held up and never tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段受困。從未能施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Slowly away, rail position in rear of mid-field, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, eased when detached 200m out.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內欄。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。二百米處被拋離時收慢。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Awkward start, settled in mid-field, short of room early in home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。直路早段空位不足。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Caught racing wide no cover in a position towards the rear, didn't respond to riding and soon left behind turning into straight. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居後列，走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時對催策毫無反應，瞬即被拋離。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W3W) Chased leaders early before sitting back in midfield, held up for clear running 400M to 300M then ran home mildly when asked. Not ridden out late stages when held up again.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 早段追趕領先馬匹，其後居中間位置。四百米處至三百米處之間受困而未能望空。直路上受催策時走勢普通。末段在再度受困之際未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back to last few from a wide barrier and waited with, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, produced good late impression inside final 250M, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後留居最後數位之內，留力候上。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。最後二百五十米追前甚多。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the inside, still well back on turn, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘， 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上超越一些已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Taken across from a wide draw, settled near last throughout the event, had some work to do top of straight but couldn't pick up speed when needed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後切入。沿途居接近包尾位置。直路初落後甚遠，但於關鍵時刻未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W5W) Bumped out of stalls, settled in mid-field, bumped 450m out and taken wider into home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W5W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。四百五十米處被碰撞，入直路時被帶出較外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, not best of runs 400m out to 200m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處至二百米處之間未能完全望空。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Taken back to race 2 wide towards rear, 8 lengths or so back turning in, taken wide in straight and made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上移出外疊。末段略為追前。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by I Am Invincible from Villa Moura, a daughter of Encosta de Lago. Horses by the same sire include Invincible Shield and Pi Legend. This fellow had one start in Australia for one win (a maiden over 1100m). He was given six trials in Hong Kong for one win and one placing. He raced handily and finished third under pressure, beaten by 2-1/2Ls, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on May 18. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and won under pressure, by 1-1/4Ls, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on August 31. He looks like a player here at the first time of asking.
formguide.comments_chi: 「至高無極」(I Am Invincible)之後，在港同父馬包括「笑傲江湖」及「偵探傳奇」等駒，生母出自「拿高」(Encosta de Lago)。來港前於澳洲一出一捷，該場為1100米從未勝出馬賽。抵港後試閘六次得一勝一位。5月18日出試從化草地1000米，早段跟前，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬2.5個馬位。最近8月31日出試從化草地1000米，早段居中，末段力策下以1.25個馬位之先勝出。初出有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, held up top of the Straight, closed off nicely once in the clear, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路初受困。末段望空後以佳勢衝刺，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Jumped well, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊，大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Began well from a tricky draw, raced better than midfield but trapped 3 wide, no cover on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路彎沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Jumped on terms, settled down behind midfield, 3-4Ls off leader coming into straight but responded only fairly and failed to trouble leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置。入直路時落後領放馬三至四個馬位，但對催策反應僅屬一般，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Settled in front of midfield, raced very wide, weakened passing 200M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間之前位置，走大外疊。跑過二百米處時轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W2W) Away well, positioned 2 wide better than midfield, 2 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W) Waited with towards rear, raced keenly throughout, dropped to last place top of home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W) 居後列，留力候上。沿途搶口。直路初墮退至包尾位置，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, well placed into home straight, ran on strongly to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until final 100M, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至一百米處，其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Jumped only fairly, settled in mid-division 4Ls behind leader, brought widest into straight before running on at the same pace. No threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，落後領放馬四個馬位。入直路時移出最外疊，其後保持同速。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, chased leader, ridden 400m out to challenge leader, no threat to winner, just held third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追趕領放馬。四百米處受催策以挑戰領放馬。末段未能威脅頭馬，僅保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Slow to begin, adopted a rearward position 6-7Ls back on settling, lay in under pressure in the home straight, kept on mildly to the line but couldn't be ridden out final 50M when awkwardly placed behind a rival.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，落後六至七個馬位。直路上在催策下內閃。末段保持普通走勢，但最後五十米在對手之後處於窘境之際未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Bumped on jumping, failed to show sufficient pace going forward and ended up behind midfield, failed to gain ground on leaders final 300M. (Jockey - travelled only fairly during the event.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，未能展現足夠前速上前，其後居中間之後位置。最後三百米未能追近領先馬匹。（騎師表示，坐騎於陣上的走勢僅屬一般。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Away quickly, stayed close to the leading pair, dashed well on straightening and took over nearing 100M before racing away to score on his first start for new trainer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，緊隨領先兩駒。入直路時加速良佳，接近一百米處時取得領先，帶離勝出。轉廄首戰即勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed approaching 200M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，其後受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。趨近二百米處時未能再增速及被超越。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, had to wait for run on bend, short of room from 300m out to 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎須等待空位出現。自三百米處起至一百米處空位不足。跑來欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Tracked pace out wide, ridden early in home straight, bumped 350m out, stayed on steadily for a clear third but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊。直路早段受催策。三百五十米處與對手互相碰撞。保持穩勢，在帶離餘駒下跑獲季軍，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, keen 1000m out, ridden top of home straight, crowded and briefly hampered 125m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。一千米處搶口。直路初受催策。一百二十五米處受擠迫及一度受阻礙。其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, followed runner-up through 400m out, strong run to lead 200m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處跟隨亞軍馬匹上前。衝刺強勁，二百米處取得領先，帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Settled outside the lead, kept on nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Sat handy, raced wide, kept on well, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走外疊。末段保持佳勢。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, 7 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後約七個馬位。末段衝刺平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W1W1W) Pressed forward, emerged as leader 850M setting good pace to straight, headed by winner near 250M, faded late to finish 6th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W1W1W) 受催策上前，八百五十米處取得領先。直路前以中等步速領放。接近二百五十米處時被頭馬超越，末段力竭，取得第六名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W) Up with leaders early stages before settling down in a trailing position just off the pace, kept on one paced under top weight on straightening, always held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W) 早段跟上領先馬匹，其後居領放馬稍後有遮擋的位置。入直路時在負頂磅下保持同速，一直落後領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Jumped well from gate 12, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, 1-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded at start, made running, race keenly throughout, headed by winner 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，帶頭競跑。沿途搶口。二百米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Taken back from the widest draw to travel 3-wide without cover towards rear in 8th, widest turning in for home, ran on under pressure down the centre of the track to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列第八位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。轉入直路時走最外疊。末段在跑道中央受催策上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路早段對催策略有反應。一百五十米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, keen middle stages, dropped to rear of mid-field on bend, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, strong run to lead on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。直路彎墮居中間之後位置。未能望空直至二百米處。衝刺強勁，終點線上取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled 3-wide in rear of midfield from a poor draw, inconvenienced 350M out, ran on dourly under pressure to gain upper hand close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自第九檔出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。三百五十米處受妨礙。末段在催策下持續力拼，接近終點時佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W) Settled at the rear, switched out top of Straight, stay on well. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W) 居尾列。直路初向外移出。保持佳勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Sat towards rear, traveled smoothly, responded well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居後列，走勢暢順。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, kept on nicely when asked, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a nose.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。在催策下保持佳勢。衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍。僅以一馬鼻位之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced in rear, switched wide for clear run 300m out, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居後列。三百米處移出外疊以望空。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W5W) Awkward start and lost ground, detached early stages, good headway halfway out, pushed along widest into home straight, passed plenty of field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W5W) 出閘笨拙及失地，早段被拋離。半程時追前甚多。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段超越多駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began awkwardly, raced as the rear over 10Ls off the pace at one stage, had task in hand leaving the bend, failed to make up ground on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，居後列，一度落後領放馬逾十個馬位。跑離直路彎時落後頗遠。未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, under pressure 600m out, unable to quicken, eased final 100m.
(Roarer again and sustained a minor abrasion to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Roarer again and sustained a minor abrasion to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。六百米處受催策，未能加速。最後一百米收慢。
（再次患有喘鳴症及右後腿輕微擦傷。）
runnerrecords.healthissue_chi: （再次患有喘鳴症及右後腿輕微擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W6W) Bumped start, raced 3 wide behind midfield, no cover for the majority of the race, very wide turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W6W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊，直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Soon taken behind from a poor draw, commenced move 4-wide rounding home bend, unbalanced briefly on straightening, ran on under pressure but run ended just inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 自第九檔出閘後瞬即留後。轉直路彎時開始上前，走第四疊。入直路時一度失去平衡。在催策下保持走勢，但跑過一百米處後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W5W) Very slowly away, trailed the field virtually throughout.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W5W) 出閘非常緩慢，沿途尾隨群駒。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, two lengths clear into home straight, headed by winner 200m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。入直路時領先兩個馬位。二百米處被頭馬超越，最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked top of home straight, headed by winner 200m out, no match for winner, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速。二百米處被頭馬超越。未能與頭馬抗衡，僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Began well to make all obtaining rails run over 1000M out, held over 1L advantage most of way before ridden clear 300M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，領放。一千米處移入內欄。大部分途程領先逾一個馬位，三百米處在催策下帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running after beginning from the one draw attempting to make all, defied serious challenge after straightening to re-gain advantage 150M out only to be denied close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後瞬即領放，嘗試一放到底。入直路後力拒對手的強勁挑戰，一百五十米處再次拉開與對手的距離。僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W) Raced wide without cover, chased along early, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W) 走外疊，沒有遮擋，早段追趕對手。直路上迅速墮退。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Soon emerged as leader and allowed to set steady pace to the straight, showed good response under pressure, challenged by rivals over final 250M but was always holding on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，直路前以平穩步速領放。對催策反應良佳。最後二百五十米受挑戰，但一直力拒對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sluggish start, taken across to rail and made up some ground into rear of mid-field, one paced home straight, no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，切入內欄，略為追前，進佔中間之後位置。直路上保持同速，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Made running, pressed in front, kicked top of home straight, headed 250m out, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 帶頭，在領放下受追迫。直路初加速。二百五十米處被超越。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Broke away swiftly and sat outside the leader, fought hard when being challenged to hold on to the victory.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬外側。末段在受挑戰之際力拼，保住勝局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to across, pressed leader, driven along 600m out to chase leader, ran on well to edge ahead final 50m in tight finish.
(Jockey dropped whip at 350M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策，切入追迫領放馬。六百米處受催策以追趕領放馬。末段走勢良佳，五十米處取得領先，僅勝。
（於三百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於三百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W) Shared early pace from a wide draw, drifted one back to 2nd 2-wide rounding home bend, folded up quickly inside final 400M.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，早段並排領先。轉直路彎時墮居第二位，走第二疊。最後四百米迅速力竭。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Settled handy, traveled comfortably, raced wide and without cover, responded nicely under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 居前列。走勢暢順。在沒有遮擋下走外疊。末段對鞭策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield, traveled only fairly, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走勢僅屬一般。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Out in line, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, peaked on turn, weakened early in straight, eased final 300M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎未能再增速。直路初轉弱。最後三百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, quickened early to lead 250m out, headed by winner 200m out, tired closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初加速，二百五十米處取得領先。二百米處被頭馬超越，末段呈現疲態。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, short of room top of home straight, checked 350m out, clear run 250m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初空位不足，三百五十米處勒避。二百五十米處望空，末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W4W) Settled worse than behind midfield 3 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W4W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, commenced move 400M, very wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W4W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。四百米處開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。直路初略為追前。最後一百米再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 10, raced 3 wide behind midfield, travelled keenly in the middle stages, wider from 550M, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 自第十檔出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。中段搶口。自五百五十米處起走更外疊。直路早段略為追前，一百五十米處未能再增速，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, no daylight early in straight, cleared 300M, closed off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。三百米處望空，以佳勢衝刺，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Began only fairly, taken back to race at rear on the inside, moved a bit closer after passing 1050M, angled out 500M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, no clear run early in straight, made minor progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列，走內疊。跑過一千零五十米處後略為追近。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路初未能望空，其後略為追前。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Casino Prince from Sequenzalot, a daughter of Camelot. Horses by the same sire include Naboo Star and Spicy Sure. This fellow had two starts in Australia for two wins (a maiden handicap over 1200m and a handicap over 1400m). He was given six trials in Hong Kong for two wins and one placing. He sat midfield and finished second under the whip, beaten by 1-1/2Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on June 8. In the latest trial, he sat not far from the pace and won under pressure, by 3/4L, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 4. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「賭場王子」(Casino Prince)之後，在港同父馬包括「肥仔威威」及「辣得很」等駒，生母出自「帝皇城堡」(Camelot)。來港前於澳洲兩戰全勝，該兩場分別為1200米從未勝出馬讓磅賽及1400米讓磅賽。抵港後試閘六次得兩勝一位。6月8日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段鞭策下跑第二名，落後頭馬1.5個馬位。最近9月4日出試從化草地1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下以0.75個馬位之先勝出。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out after passing 500M, 5 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後五個馬位。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) Dropped away from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走大外疊。最後二百米以勁勢上前，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide approaching 550M, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。趨近五百五十米處時走第二疊。末段衝刺良佳，取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Blundered start and bumped, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 5 lengths back, same margin back on turn, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時失蹄及被碰撞，居中間之後位置，落後五個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W7W) In rear after awkward start and lost balance, raced wide throughout, bumped 450m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W7W) 出閘笨拙及失去平衡，居後列。沿途走外疊。四百五十米處發生碰撞。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, stayed on fairly. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。保持一般走勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the outside, 3 lengths or so back turning in, finished off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, cleared 300M, finished off well to take 2nd, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。三百米處望空，末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, hard ridden after passing 300M, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。跑過三百米處後受力策。衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, mid division, travelled smoothly into home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。以勁勢上前，一百五十米處取得領先。末段領先距離收窄，但仍保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W) Sat rear, commenced to improve from near the 800M, held up at the early Straight, closed off strongly (See incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W) 居後列。自接近八百米處起開始推進。直路初受困。衝刺強勁。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W1W) Disputed led early stages, led outright 800m out, challenged by winner top of home straight, headed 200m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W1W) 早段爭奪領先。八百米處單騎領放。直路初被頭馬挑戰。二百米處被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly losing round, soon taken across in rear and picked up to 8th 1100M out, steadied and lost position inside the 900M, snuck closer on home turn but baulked 400M out, fought on steadily to reach distant 3rd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，瞬即切入內欄。千一米處加速推進至第八位。九百米處收慢及失位。直路彎追近，但四百米處受困。末段持續力拼，跑獲季軍，但落後頭馬甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W) From wide draw dropped back to race at the rear further back than intended, 9Ls off the pace middle stages, still some work to do top of the straight, closed off fastest to lead inside 150M. Won convincingly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居較賽前部署為後的後列位置。中段落後領放馬九個馬位。直路初仍落後頗遠。衝刺最快，一百五十米處取得領先。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight and followed winner through 350m out, stayed on well but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。三百五十米處跟隨頭馬上前。保持佳勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, wide on bend, improved to lead over 200m out, tended to edge left in front, headed late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居領先馬匹之後的啣接位置。直路彎走外疊。推進上前，二百米處取得領先。在居前競跑下傾向外閃。末段被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, stayed on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Wide throughout, made contact with rival when improving into contention on bend, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 沿途走外疊。直路彎在上前爭勝之際與對手互相觸碰。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Settled near last early stages, moved closer to midfield approaching 500M, ran on well towards the line getting up for 4th late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 早段居接近包尾位置。趨近五百米處時追近至中間位置。保持佳勢至終點，於末段取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W4W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, switched for clear run top of home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W4W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞，居中間之後位置。直路初轉換跑線以望空。最後二百米走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Stuck to inside rail throughout, mid-field, clear run in home straight, stayed on to edge ahead final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，沿途固守內欄。直路上望空。保持走勢，最後五十米取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Began awkwardly and made heavy contact, raced better than midfield on rail, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, bumped 200M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相大力觸碰，居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。二百米處發生碰撞。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W) Reserved in midfield along the fence 3-4Ls back, in similar position turning home, ran on well final 300M, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W) 沿欄留居中間位置，落後三至四個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若位置。最後三百米以佳勢上前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, tracked pace out wide, improved to press leader 900m out, ridden 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞，跟隨領放馬，走外疊。上前，九百米處追迫領放馬。四百米處受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, dropped to rear into home straight, some late gains but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時墮居後列。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Waited with towards rear, still in last place top of home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居包尾位置。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Three wide in rear without cover, some headway on bend, sustained headway in home straight, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。直路上持續追前。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，以一馬頸位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Fast into stride, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, challenged the leader turning in, hit the front approaching 300M, kept on well but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時挑戰領放馬。趨近三百米處時取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後五十米不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺強勁，以一頸位之先掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Mid-field, pushed along on bend to hold position, headway when checked briefly 250m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。直路彎受推策以保持位置。追前，二百五十米處一度勒避。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Raced in touch with leaders out wide, pushed along wide into home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 緊隨領先馬匹，走外疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Out with rest, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 450M, showed some response early in straight, no clear run near 250M, cleared 150M, made minor progress thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。四百五十米處向外移出。直路初對催策略有反應。接近二百五十米處時未能望空。一百五十米處望空。其後略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）
